(Les “B Corp” formant une communauté de sociétés qui ont décidé d’être non pas les meilleures du monde mais les meilleures POUR le monde).

Parce que notre développement repose sur des principes forts :

Un profond respect de l’ensemble de nos parties prenantes : consultant(e)s, clients et fournisseurs. Car si le travail “ne fait pas le bonheur”, il peut cependant “faire le malheur”. Nous nous engageons donc à écouter et agir avec honnêteté.
Une égalité des chances dans le traitement de nos candidatures et dans la gestion de carrière de nos salarié(e)s. Nous croyons en un milieu de travail où équité F/H, inclusion et diversité sont la norme.
Une empreinte environnementale minimale, et sociétale maximale. C’est pourquoi, au-delà des missions que vous réaliserez, vous pourrez également contribuer à des projets que Davidson soutient : missions de solidarité internationale (avec Planète Urgence), bénévolat auprès d’associations (chaque Davidsonien(ne) dispose de 3 jours par an pour intervenir à leurs côtés), accompagnement d’étudiant(e)s issus de milieux peu favorisés (avec Article 1), investissement dans des startups développant des solutions innovantes, actions collectives et individuelles pour la réduction de notre impact carbone…
Un Management adhocratique basé sur la mise en œuvre des principes de “l’entreprise horizontale” et du “management tribal”. Sur ce dernier point une précision d’importance : le bien-être au travail est un luxe qu’il faut pouvoir s’offrir en étant une entreprise “solide”. Ceci induit pour les Davidsonien(ne)s d’allier prises d’initiative, engagement et professionnalisme. Car “sans travail, le talent n’est qu’une sale manie”. Et cela nous incite à chercher à recruter des personnes… meilleures que nous…

Nous encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap, et nous nous engageons à répondre au mieux à leurs besoins spécifiques.

Mission au sein d’un programme stratégique de transformation data et IA dans un grand groupe bancaire.

Périmètre

Intervention sur le stream Data Platform (AWS Cloud), en production depuis 2022, avec des enjeux d’industrialisation, de performance et de sécurité.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

Skills And Competencies

Experience building scalable data applications using Apache Spark, with proficiency in Scala preferred and Python also acceptable
Hands-on experience working with Databricks in a cloud environment (AWS preferred)
Good understanding of distributed computing, data partitioning, and performance optimisation
Experience working with modern data formats such as Parquet, Delta Lake, and JSON
Strong SQL skills for data transformation and querying
Understanding of graph data structures, clustering techniques, and similarity approaches
Familiarity with statistical methods such as TF-IDF and similarity metrics
Proficiency with version control and build tools including Git, Gradle, Maven, or SBT
Awareness of code quality, maintainability, and testing practices using frameworks such as ScalaTest or JUnit
Experience contributing to testing approaches including unit and integration testing
Ability to use AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and support development tasks
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Effective communication skills and ability to collaborate within cross-functional teams
Willingness to learn new technologies and develop engineering expertise

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
Equivalent practical experience will also be considered

Responsibilities

Support the design, development, and optimisation of data pipelines and data processing solutions within a scalable data engineering environment

Support the design and development of Spark-based data pipelines for processing large volumes of data
Implement parsing, normalisation, and standardisation logic across datasets
Assist in developing graph-based analytics and entity resolution workflows
Build and maintain ETL workflows ingesting data from sources such as Delta Lake, Parquet, and S3
Contribute to data quality checks, validation, and incremental processing approaches
Write and maintain unit and integration tests to support reliability
Support monitoring and troubleshooting of data pipelines
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product, Data Science, and Engineering
Document data flows and technical solutions
Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices

Join our Data Engineering team, responsible for building scalable data pipelines across Change Data Capture, Entity Resolution, and Data Mastering

You will work on large-scale data challenges in a collaborative environment, contributing to high-quality data solutions and developing your technical capabilities.The team is embracing a more AI-enabled way of working, with a focus on automation, insight generation, and continuous innovation

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description

Sopra Steria offers tailored, end-to-end corporate technology and software solutions to help clients make bold choices and deliver results. Successfully so! With more than 51.000 colleagues in nearly 30 countries, we rank as Europe’s leading digital solutions provider. Some of the most successful companies in Europe rely on our technology due to our commitment to innovation, collaboration, and value in business development.

Job Description

Join our Data & AI team.

You will become part of a multidisciplinary team where data engineering, architecture, AI, analytics, governance and visualization come together. Together, we help clients get more value out of their data: from setting up the right data foundations to building dashboards, analytics solutions and AI use cases that support better decisions.

As a Data Engineer, will work with modern data technologies to develop and manage end-to-end data solutions, from ingestion and transformation to serving layers. In close collaboration with other data experts (BI consultants, AI engineers, etc.) and client stakeholders, you will translate business and analytics requirements into production-ready, end-to-end data systems.

You will be part of our Data Foundation practice: a team of data engineers and architects, within our Data & AI department. Looking beyond the sleek dashboards and hype-driven AI applications, we make sure that AI and BI initiatives are powered by a reliable and performant back end. Using proven components and best practices, we continuously challenge ourselves to design solutions tailored to our clients’ data needs, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and maintainability.

Your responsibilities include the following:

Build high-quality data solutions that create value for our clients.
Gather business requirements and translate them to technical specifications.
Design, implement and orchestrate scalable and efficient data pipelines to collect, process, and serve large datasets.
Contribute to sales proposals and business development initiatives.
Engage in knowledge-sharing and support more junior colleagues.
Serve as a subject matter expert for client advisory.

Qualifications

We’re seeking motivated colleagues who are eager to engineer the best solutions for our clients and to be an active member of our team of experts. If you enjoy tackling complex technical problems and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application!

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following:

At least 3 years of experience as a Data Engineer or in software engineering in a data context.
Programming experience with one or more languages, such as Python.
Knowledge of storage concepts/technologies (RDBs, DWHs, lakehouses, etc.) and distributed computing.
Experience in designing, building and owning data pipelines (Databricks, dbt, Airflow, ...)
Experience with at least one cloud provider (Azure, AWS or GCP).
Experience with incremental and streaming workloads, CDC and SCD.
Familiar with platform engineering (including CI/CD and IaC automation) in a data mesh-like context.
The concept of DataOps is embedded in your way of working.
Familiar with the challenges of BI and AI workloads and applications.
Experienced in implementing data governance & security (IAM, data quality mgmt, metadata mgmt., ...).
Aware of currently available technologies and upcoming data trends.
Ability to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.
Able to work autonomously, balance multiple stakeholders, make pragmatic technical decisions and manage work time effectively.
Strong communicative and interpersonal skills, bridging technical and business audiences while building strong client and team relationships.
Collaborative and team-oriented, helping our team grow.
You have a degree in Computer Engineering, Information Technology or related field.
You are proficient in English and Dutch or French

What We Can Offer You

At Sopra Steria, you’ll join our Data Foundations Practice within the Data & AI team: a group of experts building modern data platforms that power analytics and AI.

We design scalable, secure and maintainable data pipelines and architectures using best practices and tools like Databricks, Azure, SQL and Snowflake.

You’ll help build the backbone of Data & AI, improving reliability and data quality through automation, testing and monitoring, within a collaborative and fast-learning environment.

As part of Sopra Steria, you’ll also benefit from strong career development opportunities, both locally and internationally, supported by the Sopra Steria Academy and a wider network of more than 51.000 professionals.

Additional Information

We offer a generous employee benefits package that includes:

A variety of perks, such as mobility options (including a company car), insurance coverage, meal vouchers, eco-cheques, and more.
Continuous learning opportunities through the Sopra Steria Academy to support your career development.
The opportunity to connect with fellow Sopra Steria colleagues at various team events.

Our goal is to build high-functioning teams and healthy team environments that inspire and help each other to deliver excellence for each of our customers.

Excited about this job opportunity? Great! We are looking forward to your application!

jobs.title: Fabric Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Bouw jij graag end-to-end data pipelines en dataplatformen in de Microsoft Fabric?
Vertaal je complexe businessvragen moeiteloos naar slimme, schaalbare oplossingen?
Ken jij Fabric van OneLake tot DirectLake en van notebook tot deployment pipeline?

Dan ben jij
de Fabric Data Engineer die we zoeken!

Jouw impact

Als Fabric Data Engineer bij EpicData zorg je ervoor dat data toegankelijk, schaalbaar en waardevol wordt binnen het Microsoft-ecosysteem. Je denkt én bouwt mee aan oplossingen die zowel technisch als functioneel kloppen, met Microsoft Fabric als fundament.
Je zet end-to-end platformen op in Fabric: van ingestie via Data Factory, over transformaties in notebooks en een medallion-architectuur in de Lakehouse, tot Direct Lake-modellen waar Power BI rechtstreeks op draait. Daarnaast adviseer je klanten over hoe ze Fabric slim, veilig en kostenbewust inzetten, en neem je die rol op als teamspeler, inhoudelijk expert of technische lead, net wat de situatie vraagt.
Kortom: jij bent de schakel tussen data en business, en Fabric is jouw werkterrein.

Wat ga je doen?

Data toegankelijk maken

Robuuste pipelines bouwen met Fabric Data Factory (pipelines, Copy Jobs en Dataflows Gen2) die data betrouwbaar van bron tot OneLake brengen
Transformaties uitwerken in Fabric notebooks met PySpark en Spark SQL, bovenop Delta-tabellen
Verschillende, vaak rommelige databronnen samenbrengen via connectors, Shortcuts en Mirroring
Een medallion-architectuur (bronze, silver, gold) opzetten in Lakehouse en Warehouse
Datamodellen ontwerpen, van klassiek dimensioneel volgens Kimball tot Direct Lake semantic models voor Power BI

De brug zijn tussen data en business

Klanten adviseren hoe ze Fabric kunnen inzetten in hun processen, of hoe ze vanuit Azure Synapse, Data Factory of SQL Server naar Fabric migreren
Meedenken over workspace-structuur, capacity-sizing en governance
Meebeslissen over de juiste aanpak, of dat nu als teamspeler, expert of technisch aanspreekpunt is
Technische keuzes vertalen naar taal die niet-technische collega's en klanten begrijpen

Innoveren

Nieuwe Fabric-features uittesten, zoals Real-Time Intelligence (Eventstreams, Eventhouse, KQL) en Copilot in Fabric, en waar zinvol integreren
CI/CD opzetten met Git-integratie (Azure DevOps of GitHub) en deployment pipelines
Continu zoeken naar manieren om pipelines sneller, stabieler of goedkoper te maken, met oog voor Capacity Unit-verbruik

Wie ben jij?

Je combineert sterke technische vaardigheden met een goed gevoel voor de business achter de data.
Je begrijpt dat een pipeline pas geslaagd is wanneer de data die eruit komt betrouwbaar, bruikbaar en schaalbaar is.

Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:
Idealiter drie jaar ervaring (of meer) als Data Engineer, waarvan minstens een deel hands-on in Microsoft Fabric
Kennis van de volledige data lifecycle: van datamodellering & ETL tot governance en deployment
Diepgaande kennis van dimensionele modellen volgens Kimball tot moderne lakehouse-architecturen
SQL en Python en PySpark zijn jouw krachtigste tools om data te structureren, transformeren en optimaliseren
Ervaring met het bredere Microsoft-dataplatform (Azure Data Factory, Synapse, SQL Server, Power BI) is een sterke troef
Een certificering als Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700) of Fabric Analytics Engineer (DP-600) is een plus, of je bent bereid ze te behalen
Je kan vlot schakelen tussen business en IT
Je communiceert sterk in het Nederlands en Engels
Je denkt in oplossingen, niet in problemen
Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en je deelt graag kennis
Je hebt gevoel voor humor (dat helpt meer dan je denkt)

Waarom consultants voor EpicData kiezen

Omdat je impact maakt

Je werkt mee aan projecten die organisaties écht vooruithelpen. Geen eindeloze statusmeetings of rapporten voor in de schuif, maar oplossingen die dagdagelijks gebruikt worden.

Omdat je blijft groeien

Of je nu starter bent of expert: je krijgt ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.
Tweewekelijkse Lunch & Learns
Driemaandelijkse Learning Labs
Ieder jaar een eigen Personal Development Plan
Tijd & budget om te leren, certificeren én experimenteren

Omdat AI geen buzzword is

Van analyse en development tot documentatie en klantinteractie: we gebruiken AI dagelijks om slimmer, sneller én beter te werken. Iedere Epic'er krijgt toegang tot state-of-the-art tools zodat je vanaf dag één mee bent met de technologie van morgen.

Omdat je dicht bij huis werkt

Onze klanten bevinden zich tussen Brussel en Antwerpen.
Sommige projecten duren twee weken, andere een jaar. We zoeken bewust projecten die aansluiten bij jouw expertise én je woon-werksituatie.

Wat maakt EpicData écht anders?

Wij geloven niet in afgelijnde functies.
We geloven in mensen die willen groeien.
Wil je doorgroeien naar andere technologieën? Data Architect? Team Lead? Data Strategist? Project Manager? Partner?
Dan helpen we je daar graag gericht naartoe.
Jij bepaalt de richting én je snelheid. Wij zorgen voor de kansen.

Omdat je erbij hoort

Bij EpicData sta je er niet alleen voor. Je maakt deel uit van een inclusief & hecht team dat voor elkaar dé extra mile gaat: collega's die inspringen wanneer het nodig is, meedenken wanneer het kan en regelmatig samen hun successen vieren. Van afterworks tot teambuildings, activiteiten met het team zijn geen uitzondering maar een gewoonte en op elkaar kunnen rekenen is dé norm.

EpicData HQ

Daarnaast krijg je ook toegang tot ons Epic kantoor :
Gratis warm buffet elke middag
Fantastisch dakterras met lekkere koffie
Eigen cinemazaal, gebedsruimte, pooltafel, kicker én darts
Padelvelden aan het kantoor
Wekelijkse Afterwork op vrijdag
Jaarlijkse Workation
Jaarlijkse Bike Challenge

En natuurlijk...

Is er ook een aantrekkelijk loonpakket met héél wat extralegale voordelen. Je rijdt rond met een leuke bedrijfswagen mét een Benelux-laadkaart, of kom je liever met de fiets, dan is er ook een fietsvergoeding. Daarnaast geniet je van de flexibiliteit van een cafetariaplan. Je krijgt een dagelijkse maaltijdvergoeding en hoeft nooit zelf je gsm- of internetabonnement thuis te betalen. Elk jaar krijg je ecocheques en een koopkrachtpremie erbovenop. Ook aan je rust, gezondheid en toekomst is gedacht: met 31 verlofdagen bouw je ruim tijd op om je batterijen op te laden en dankzij een hospitalisatie-, ambulante en groepsverzekering zit je goed verzekerd.

Daarnaast hebben we ook het EpicData Rewards-programma, waarmee je extra euro's kan verdienen door EpicData mee vooruit te helpen.

Liever je eigen verloningspakket kiezen? Ook dat kan: bij EpicData maak je evengoed de sprong naar freelancer, met een vast tarief ongeacht de klant waarvoor je aan de slag gaat.

Meer weten?

Kijk dan zeker even op onze socials: LinkedIn , Instagram of op onze FAQ over werken bij EpicData.

Klaar om impact te maken?!

Solliciteer dan vandaag nog en kom langs voor een lunch op ons kantoor.
Dan ontdekken we samen of jouw volgende carrièrestap even Epic kan worden als wij denken.

See you soon!

jobs.title: Senior Java ETL Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Our SynaptiQ platform collects near-real-time data from more than 20 million devices across thousands of utility-scale solar and wind sites worldwide. Everything the platform does — the analytics, the alarming, the reporting our clients run their portfolios on — depends on that data arriving complete, on time and correctly normalised. To keep that foundation solid as the portfolio grows, we are looking for a Senior Java ETL Data Engineer to own the technical direction of the engine that makes it happen.

You will join our Product Engineering organisation, working in a small cross-functional team of 2–3 engineers and reporting to an Engineering Manager. You will work closely with Product Management to define both what gets built and how it is implemented, and with Operations when things break. The working language is English. Day to day you will be in high-performance Java, S3-compatible object storage (S3, ABS, GCS), streaming infrastructure, and Linux.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will own the ETL engine — not a slice of it - and day-to-day:
You design, develop and operate the Java ETL engine that processes near-real-time data from millions of renewable energy assets. Ownership here runs from conception through to production operation: you build it, you run it, you fix it.
You architect and integrate the engine with S3-compatible object storage and streaming infrastructure. Deciding how and when we adopt a given storage or streaming technology is your call to make and justify.
You balance the technical trade-offs between real-time and batch processing, and make those calls on evidence rather than preference.
You take the lead on quality and reliability through code review, testing and SRE practice — including incident response and postmortem analysis when something goes wrong at 2am on a Sunday.
You decompose pipeline problems into actionable milestones and plans, so the team knows what "done" looks like before work starts.
You maintain the architecture decisions, runbooks and API documentation that let the rest of us operate what you build.

We are looking for someone who takes an idea all the way to production and stays with it afterwards. Someone technically rigorous, who writes high-performance concurrent Java and genuinely cares how systems behave under load at three in the morning. And someone pragmatic — who knows when to ship and when to slow down and do it properly.

To qualify as our ideal candidate:
You have 7+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 3 years writing and operating high-performance Java in production.
You have a deep understanding of Java concurrency, parallelism and performance optimisation. This is the core of the job — the engine handles millions of devices, and naive code does not survive contact with that volume.
You have hands-on experience with data processing pipelines on S3-compatible object storage, and you are comfortable with Linux system administration.
You have delivered and operated production systems end-to-end — code review, testing, monitoring, incident response.
You are an architectural thinker. You evaluate technologies on evidence and guide the team toward sound choices rather than fashionable ones.
You hold a Master's in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent by experience.
You speak and write fluent English. It is our working language across engineering.
You can work autonomously: we don't have a micromanagement culture around here. Processes are light and we expect you to find information independently, ask for help when you need it, and improve the process rather than wait for one.
You can explain a technical trade-off to someone who isn't an engineer — Product and Operations need to understand the consequences of your decisions to make their own.

Bonus points for

Streaming platforms — Kafka, Flink or Pulsar
Time-series databases
Renewable energy sector experience

Our offices are hidden in the centre of Brussels with a view on a pond, with ducks and a heron bringing a regular visit. In addition to a stimulating atmosphere in a highly motivated group of people, 3E offers a unique opportunity to further develop yourself in a company/team with an ambitious growth plan, delivering innovative services.

Furthermore:
Training
on the job by our experts so you get to know our solution and work in and out
Flexibility, responsibility and freedom
in your day-to-day work.
An international
environment with projects in over 100 countries worldwide, colleagues of over 20 nationalities.

We are open to both independent contractors (commitment to 219 invoiced days/year) or payroll contracts. For a Belgian payroll contract, the extralegal benefits
are:
Home working (2 days per week)

Pension saving

€9 meal voucher/day
flexible income plan

sustainable transport subscription and/or bike allowance (€0.36/km).

jobs.title: AI-Augmented Data Engineer F/M
jobs.description:
WE ARE BETCLIC
🎯

Betclic, European leader in sports betting, is much more than just an online gaming site! Also offering Poker, Horse Racing, and Casino games across various countries and continents, it is an inspiring and forward-thinking company: every day brings new challenges in a modern and dynamic environment. As an influential player in the tech industry, with strong and sustained growth over the years, we believe in innovation through diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone to reach their full potential. With our multicultural team, we provide an optimal, safe and responsible gaming experience, powered by cutting-edge technology.

WHY JOIN US?
🚀

At Betclic, success comes from passionate and committed teams. Here’s why you’ll love working with us:

💡An international and creative environment where every project is an opportunity to innovate

📈Hypergrowth that brings new challenges and development opportunities every day

🏡A healthy work-life balance: flexible remote work and workplace well-being are essential pillars for us.

🌟A unique and friendly atmosphere, with 1,600 employees across 5 countries and our headquarters in Bordeaux

Are you passionate about sports and tech? Join us and help shape the future of online gaming!

ENTER THE GAME
🎮

At Betclic, data is at the heart of our products, our decisions, and the experience of millions of players across Europe and Africa.

As part of our GOAT 2030 strategic plan, Groundbreaking, Original, AI Everywhere, Trustworthy, we are building the next generation of Data Engineering: cloud-native, as-code, self-service, agentic, and AI-augmented.

We are not just looking for a Data Engineer. We are looking for a curious, creative and demanding professional who knows how to approach problems differently, accelerate delivery with AI, and share a modern culture of data engineering.

You will join one of our business-oriented data squads: Sports, Casino, Poker, Horse Racing, Payment, Account, Growth/Marketing, Safer Gaming, Fraud, Care, or Support Functions.

Your work will have a direct impact on major sports events, real-time player experience, content personalization, frictionless payment processes, fraud prevention, responsible gaming, compliance, and business performance.

The visible part for our business teams is Omni and self-serve analytics. The real engine is what you build behind it: reliable, scalable, tested, documented data products used every day by teams who truly depend on them.

You will evolve within a fast-growing tech company, in an autonomous domain-oriented squad, with a strong product culture and a clear ambition: making AI a concrete lever for excellence, growth, and performance.

YOUR ROLE WITHIN BETCLIC
🔥

In this role, your main missions will be:

Design, build, and maintain robust data pipelines.
Model data for analytics, BI, AI, and self-service use cases.
Build Bronze, Silver, Gold, Semantic Layer, and Exposition Layer data models.
Transform complex business problems into simple, durable, and scalable data products.
Contribute to the increasing challenges of reactivity, freshness, and near real-time data needs.
Implement a complete Tech Flow based on an “as-code everywhere” approach, covering the full delivery lifecycle: design, build, testing, integration, deployment, documentation, and monitoring.
Improve the quality, performance, governance, and observability of our data pipelines.

TECHNICAL ENVIRONMENT

You will work in a modern, cloud-native, production-grade data environment including:

Snowflake
dbt
Airflow
GitHub Actions
SQL
Omni
Full Cloud
CI/CD
Everything as-code
ChatGPT / Codex
Claude Code

Upcoming technologies and areas of exploration include Iceberg Tables, ClickHouse, and other next-generation data engineering solutions.

At Betclic, AI is not a gadget. It is part of the way we design, code, document, test, challenge, and accelerate projects.

We expect a real culture around:

ChatGPT, Codex, and Claude Code
Prompts, rules, skills, agents, and customized workflows
Agentic solution design
Vibe engineering applied to production-grade contexts

⚡Let’s be clear: if AI is only an improved search engine for you, this role is probably not the right fit.

👍But if you have already built your own methods, prompts, rules, agents, or skills to work faster and better, we definitely want to hear from you.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?
🔍

We are looking for passionate and curious professionals who bring kindness and a touch of enthusiasm !

This job is for you if:

You have at least 4 years of solid experience in a demanding data, analytics, BI engineering, or software engineering environment with a strong data focus.
You have strong experience with modern Data Engineering or Analytics Engineering practices.
You are technically curious, creative, and constantly learning.
You are demanding when it comes to quality, performance, scalability, and maintainability.
You are able to transform unclear business needs into clear and reliable data solutions.
You are comfortable working in autonomous squads and cloud environments.
You enjoy automation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
You understand the value of product-oriented data engineering.
You are excited by AI-augmented ways of working and already use AI tools to improve your productivity and delivery quality.
You are motivated by building data products that are used every day and create measurable business impact.
And finally, you speak English fluently

This is a permanent position only: we are not looking for contractors, freelancers or independent consultants. We are looking for people ready to commit
for the long run and fully embrace the Betclic journey
with us.

WHAT ARE THE RECRUITMENT STEPS?
📝

If your application is shortlisted, Maxime will contact you within a week for an initial HR screening (30 minutes).

Then, you will complete the AssessFirst test (personality, motivation and cognitive reasoning).

Next, you will meet your futur Manager.

You will then have a technical discussion with one of our Data Engineering experts.

Finally, you will be invited for an immersion session in our offices.

The recruitment process usually takes between 4 to 6 weeks to ensure an optimal experience for you.

WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT?
🎁

✅ 25 days of paid leave and 10 RTT days

🍽️ A Ticket Restaurant® card credited with €11 per day (€6 per day funded by Betclic)

🩺 100% health insurance coverage for you and your children

🚆 50% reimbursement of public transport costs or an annual sustainable mobility allowance (€230 for commuting with sustainable transport)

🏡 Hybrid work model

📚 Access to a vast training catalog, with opportunities for professional development every year

🏢 Extraordinary office spaces with a rooftop where you can enjoy sunny breaks with a view of the Cité du Vin

🎉 Internal events to liven up your daily life

🏋️ On-site sports classes and organized tournaments (Pilates, circuit training, boxing, yoga, futsal, padel, tennis…)

Permanent contract, available immediately in Bordeaux, remote work possible from another city (on-site presence required 4 days a month) Betclic Group – 117 Quai de Bacalan, 33300 BORDEAUX

Une bonne compréhension des concepts de la chaîne décisionnelle (modélisation, reporting...).

1 manager pour 18 consultants max, des points projet structurés et un canal direct vers les RH chaque mois via Express Yourself .

291 agents IA développés en interne, chez Mantu, AI = Artificial Intelligence & Augmented Impact. +250 modules de formation et certifications Microsoft financées à 100 %.

Chez Amaris, nous avons à cœur d'offrir à nos candidats la meilleure expérience de recrutement possible. jobs.description:
Pourquoi rejoindre Keyrus aujourd'hui ?

Keyrus
est un groupe international de 2 800 consultants
et experts présents dans 28 pays
, porté par une conviction forte : ce n'est pas l'intelligence artificielle qui transforme les entreprises, mais l'intelligence conçue, structurée et intégrée à leur fonctionnement.

Depuis plus de 30 ans, nous construisons les fondations data qui permettent aux systèmes intelligents de créer de la valeur. Nous concevons le système d'exploitation de l'entreprise intelligente, où la donnée, l'IA et l'expertise humaine s'intègrent au cœur des processus métiers pour générer une performance durable. Chez Keyrus, nous donnons vie à l'intelligence opérationnelle.

L'intelligence artificielle ne remplace pas l'humain. Elle lui permet de se concentrer sur ce qu'aucun système ne peut reproduire : comprendre, décider, concevoir et innover. Rejoindre Keyrus, c'est construire son jugement, son expertise et sa capacité à résoudre des problématiques complexes.

La technologie est un accélérateur. La culture Keyrus fait la différence. L'excellence opérationnelle permet de relier les deux.

Data Engineer

Le Data Engineer prépare et fiabilise la donnée qui alimente les systèmes intelligents : pipelines robustes, plateformes data modernes, exposition de la donnée aux agents autant qu'aux tableaux de bord. Sans donnée prête et gouvernée, aucun système d'IA ne tient en production.

Ce qui vous attend

Vous concevez et industrialisez des pipelines de données robustes, de la donnée brute jusqu'à son exploitation par les applications et les agents.
Vous déployez et exploitez des plateformes data modernes (lakehouse, entrepôts cloud) pour rendre la donnée accessible, gouvernée et performante à l'échelle.
Vous rendez la donnée exploitable par des systèmes d'IA générative et agentique (Anthropic, OpenAI, Mistral, Google Gemini, etc.) : structuration pour le RAG, alimentation de bases vectorielles, préparation de jeux de données pour l'évaluation de modèles.
Vous garantissez la qualité, la fraîcheur et la traçabilité de la donnée par des tests et des contrats de données, pas seulement par une supervision manuelle.
Vous transformez rapidement une maquette en preuve de concept exploitable, pour valider un cas d'usage avant d'industrialiser le pipeline définitif.
Vous mettez en place la restitution (BI, tableaux de bord) lorsque le cas d'usage l'exige, en complément de l'exposition de la donnée aux agents.

Ce que vous apportez

Le socle Architect of Intelligence :
des qualités indispensables, présentes dans les critères ci-dessous : curiosité, créativité, communication, conscience professionnelle, culture, capacité à faire.

Expérience et parcours

Une expérience significative de conception et d'industrialisation de pipelines de données en production, quel que soit votre point de départ : ESN, éditeur, startup, ou client final.
Une pratique avérée des plateformes data modernes (cloud ou lakehouse), au-delà de l'ETL traditionnel.
Une expérience, si possible, de préparation de données au service de systèmes d'IA générative ou agentique.

Posture et savoir-être

Une rigueur d'ingénierie sur la qualité et la fiabilité de la donnée : une donnée non fiable invalide tout ce qui est construit au-dessus.
Une curiosité pour les usages permis par la donnée que vous préparez, au-delà du pipeline lui-même.
Une capacité à collaborer avec l'AI Engineer et le Foundations Architect sur l'exposition de la donnée aux modèles et aux agents.
Une autonomie réelle pour transformer un besoin encore mal défini en preuve de concept exploitable.
Une capacité à produire, documenter et transmettre les pipelines que vous construisez, pour qu'ils restent exploitables au-delà de votre présence sur la mission.

Compétences techniques indispensables

Maîtrise avancée de SQL, socle non négociable quel que soit le langage dominant.
Maîtrise d'un langage de pipeline en profondeur : Python en priorité, Java ou Scala selon l'écosystème (Spark, Kafka).
Mise en œuvre de traitements distribués avec Apache Spark.
Orchestration de pipelines de données avec Airflow ou Dagster.
Transformation de données industrialisée avec dbt.
Déploiement et exploitation de plateformes data cloud (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks).
Conception d'architectures de streaming et de traitement de données en temps réel (Kafka), lorsque le cas d'usage l'exige.
Utilisation de bases de données vectorielles pour des cas d'usage RAG (Pinecone, Milvus, Chroma, ou équivalent).
Compréhension pratique du prompting et de la préparation de jeux de données pour l'évaluation de modèles de langage (Anthropic, OpenAI, Mistral, Google Gemini, etc.).
Mise en place de tests et de contrats de données pour garantir la qualité et l'observabilité de la donnée.
Modélisation et préparation de données pour des usages analytiques et opérationnels.
Prototypage rapide à l'aide d'outils légers (Streamlit) pour transformer une maquette en preuve de concept exploitable.
Production, documentation et transmission des pipelines, pour qu'ils restent exploitables au-delà de votre présence.
Anglais professionnel courant, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, indispensable quel que soit le niveau d'expérience.

Ce qui nous anime

Intelligence Collective

La collaboration entre expertises, métiers et géographies nous permet de combiner les savoir-faire et d'apporter des réponses plus complètes aux défis de nos clients.

Fiabilité

Notre capacité à délivrer des projets complexes avec rigueur et exigence constitue l'un des fondements de la relation de confiance que nous construisons avec nos clients.

Pragmatisme

Nous privilégions l'impact concret et la création de valeur mesurable plutôt que les discours technologiques abstraits.

Esprit Entrepreneurial

La curiosité, l'énergie et l'autonomie sont au cœur de notre culture. Elles favorisent l'initiative, l'innovation et le développement continu de nos expertises.

À propos de Keyrus

Chez Keyrus, nous accompagnons les organisations dans leur passage d'une IA expérimentale à une IA industrialisée, d'agents isolés à des systèmes orchestrés, et de l'analyse à l'exécution. C'est cette expertise que nous appelons l'Architecture de l'Intelligence.

Grâce à notre modèle propriétaire Human Orchestrated Model™ (HOM), nous concevons des environnements intelligents reposant sur trois piliers fondamentaux : des fondations data et intelligence robustes et fiables ; une gouvernance garantissant que l'humain reste au cœur de la décision ; des mécanismes de pilotage de la performance permettant une amélioration continue.

Fort de plus de 30 ans d'expertise et de 2 800 collaborateurs répartis dans 28 pays, Keyrus accompagne les entreprises bien au-delà de leur transformation.

Keyrus est coté sur Euronext Growth Paris (ALKEY – Code ISIN : FR0004029411).

Reports to: Business Intelligence Lead

Location: Rotterdam, the Netherlands or Brussels, Belgium

Local employment conditions apply, full-time

Salary range: €64,800 - €81,000 gross per year, including holiday allowance and based on relevant experience.

About Unilever Food Solutions

Unilever Food Solutions (UFS) is a global foodservice business focused on serving chefs and professional kitchens. Operating across more than 70 countries, our purpose is to free chefs to love what they do.

We have an ambitious growth strategy towards 2030, focused on delivering superior products, becoming a leader in AI-powered customer experience, and using data and technology to better understand and serve our customers. From identifying emerging culinary trends through our Future Menus Report to developing innovative solutions for chefs, we aim to stay ahead of a rapidly evolving foodservice industry.

At UFS, you’ll work in an entrepreneurial environment built on speed, simplicity, trust and ownership. Our teams are empowered to work end-to-end, collaborate across functions and turn ideas into real business impact.

If you’re excited by the opportunity to use data and technology to help shape a growing global B2B business, we’d love to hear from you.

Main purpose of the job

The Data Engineer builds and maintains data systems. They construct datasets that are easy to analyse and support company requirements. They implement methods to improve data reliability and quality. They combine raw information from different sources to create consistent and machine-readable formats. They also develop and test architectures that enable data extraction and transformation for predictive or prescriptive modelling. Key interfaces: Central & Local Data Teams (BNX), MCO Digital Team (BNX).

Main Accountabilities

Will turn raw data (SSD, Digital and other sources) into structured data so it can be used for other purposes, is also in charge of shaping and improving the Global Data Lake (currently UDL) and Data Warehouse solution
Will be the owner of structuring data in and end-to-end way, so it can be used to (a) set up reporting, (b) perform analyses to improve business decisions and (c) automate recurring processes and tasks
Will build algorithms and prototypes that can be used to extract and transform data for predictive or prescriptive modelling, as well as grow our business structurally
Will proactively look for ways to enhance data quality and reliability to increase business productivity, as well as hit our business goals more consistently
Looks for ways to collect additional data points that can help us grow the business more quickly
Will collaborate intensely with data scientists, data analysts and architects in the central and local teams
Ensuring that your work remains backed up and readily accessible to relevant coworkers.
Remaining up-to-date with industry standards and technological advancements that will improve the quality of your outputs.

What you will need to succeed

Key Skills

Strong communication skills
Team Player that can work cross-functional (both with marketing and sales-oriented roles)
Curious about the latest developments in data and a clear understanding of how organizations can leverage these opportunities
The ability to work comfortably in a collaborative setting
Technical expertise with data models, data mining, and segmentation techniques
Hands-on experience with SQL database design
Great numerical and analytical skills
Expert proficiency in Python, C++, Java, R, and SQL.
Familiarity with Hadoop or suitable equivalent.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
A knack for independence and group work.
Scrupulous approach to duties.
Capacity to successfully manage a pipeline of duties with minimal supervision.
You know the latest data security measures and apply them rigorously, securely managing and storing data to protect it from loss or theft
Fluent in English and Dutch. French is a plus.

Relevant Experience

MSc in Computer Science, Data Science, Management Information Systems, Statistics, Analytics or any other related field
5+ years of working experience
Proven track as a Data professional in high-paced, executive environments
Experience in Data science tools (e.g. 'R')
You have a background as a data engineer, software developer or similar

Desirable

Data engineering certification (e.g IBM Certified Data Engineer) is a plus
Knowledge of Google Analytics, Marketo and Salesforce Sales Cloud or any other relevant digital marketing tools

What is in it for you?

Unilever is the place where you can be yourself and bring your purpose to life with the work that you do – creating a better business and a better world. We offer an exciting & dynamic work environment where you can make things happen. Furthermore, we offer some great reward and benefits!

Attractive total remuneration package: excellent company pension, bonus, share scheme
Flexible cross-disciplinary career opportunities and a wealth of training opportunities & wellbeing resources whenever and wherever
Plenty of company-paid holidays to further ensure your work-life balance is maintained
We encourage an inclusive culture, which comes to life with interchangeable public holidays, paid paternity leave of 6 weeks and our transgender policy
Under the Hybrid Working principles, you will be expected to spend a minimum of 60% in the office or at customers, suppliers or partners to connect and collaborate. For the time you work from home, we will ensure you are well equipped. When you are at the office, you can enjoy our tasty canteen with prepped food and own products
Informal culture and being the first one trying our new products
My Fitness Plan (deduction on your Fitness Subscription)
Home working allowance
Company laptop and mobile phone
Green Mobility Policy

Excited?

Join Unilever and our team! To apply, please do so online. Please do not forget to upload your CV and a cover letter. Your application will be reviewed against our requirements, and we will be in touch shortly after the closing date to provide you with an update on the status of your application.

Looking forward to meeting you!

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, disability, age, parenthood, pregnancy or any other basis protected by applicable law, and will not be discriminated against. By highlighting the gender diversity at the workplace, Unilever encourages applications from all genders. If you are looking for a job after a long career break or after any type of leave, do not hesitate to apply.

: Build the foundation for how Lansweeper measures growth: ARR, retention, expansion, and forecasting. Your work will shape how C-level leaders, the board, sales, and finance understand performance and planning.

Product Insights
: Build the pipelines and models that show how customers adopt and use our products. Your work will help product teams decide what to build next and help customer success spot risk and opportunity early.

Both roles share one goal: connecting commercial performance with product behavior, so the business can see not just what is happening, but why. In the near term, you’ll help establish a single source of truth for your domain’s KPIs, build reliable, board- and leadership-ready reporting, and enable the forecasting and insight models that drive go-to-market and product decisions.

You don’t need to know our products or industry already. Curiosity, strong engineering fundamentals, and an interest in the business side of data matter more.

6-12 Month Goals

Develop a strong understanding of the data platform, architecture, and key data flows supporting business reporting and analytics.
Become a trusted partner for internal stakeholders by delivering reliable, well-structured, and scalable data solutions that support decision-making.
Improve the quality, consistency, and availability of data by strengthening pipelines, models, and data management practices.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions.
Support the company’s data maturity by enabling better access to trusted data and contributing to a scalable analytics foundation.

Challenges

The Main Challenges You'll Face Are:

Working within a growing organization where data sources, systems, and business processes have evolved over time and may have been customized to meet specific needs.
Designing scalable and maintainable data solutions in an environment where requirements may change frequently as the business grows.
Ensuring data quality, consistency, and reliability across multiple systems and pipelines, while managing dependencies and complexity.
Translating business needs into technical implementations that are both practical and aligned with long-term platform standards.

Key Responsibilities

For both roles:

Build, maintain, and improve data pipelines and models that power executive-level reporting and board-ready metrics in your focus area
Establish a single, trusted source of truth for your domain’s KPIs, reconciling data across systems of record
Build the curated data models and semantic layer that power dashboards and reporting, in partnership with analysts
Partner with business stakeholders (sales operations, finance, product, customer success) to understand evolving processes and reflect them accurately in our data models
Investigate data anomalies and trace them back to their source (pipeline issue, upstream system change, or genuine business shift), then work with stakeholders to resolve them
Proactively improve data quality and integrity across your pipelines to ensure consistent, reliable reporting
Month-end close support: Reporting is time-critical at month-end. When the end of the month falls on a weekend, you’ll be part of a rotation to monitor the pipelines and make sure the numbers are ready for finance and leadership on the next business day. This is occasional and planned in advance, and the load is shared across the team.

Revenue Analytics Track:

Own revenue data models covering ARR, MRR, churn, expansion, contraction, and renewal cycles
Reconcile revenue data across CRM, billing, and ERP to produce one consistent view of financial KPIs
Build and maintain the data foundation for forecasting models, working with analysts to support go-to-market planning
Work closely with sales and finance operations to keep revenue models aligned with how the business actually sells and bills

Product Insights Track:

Own product usage and adoption data models covering active usage, feature adoption, engagement, and customer health
Integrate product telemetry with commercial data (accounts, subscriptions, renewals) so usage can be tied to retention and expansion
Define and maintain product KPIs together with product management and customer success
Build the foundations of the self-serve dashboards and insight models that help product teams prioritize and help customer success spot risk and opportunity early

Key Requirements

For both roles:

Hard skills:
Strong SQL: you can write, optimize, and debug complex queries against large datasets
Data modelling: familiarity with best practices such as dimensional modelling and slowly changing dimensions
Pipeline engineering: experience building and maintaining reliable, tested data pipelines, including monitoring and data quality checks
Supporting reporting: experience preparing data models that feed business-facing dashboards and reports
Strong plus: experience with Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran

Soft skills:
Business understanding: you take the time to understand how the business works and why the numbers matter, and you can explain technical decisions and data issues in plain language to non-technical colleagues
Stakeholder collaboration: you work well with analysts, finance, sales ops, product, and customer success, adapting your communication to each
Ownership mindset: you take initiative, work independently, and drive outcomes without waiting to be directed
Reliability: you’re comfortable owning time-critical deliverables, including occasional month-end weekend monitoring as part of a team rotation

Revenue Analytics Track:

SaaS financial metrics: solid understanding of how revenue, bookings, churn, ARR, MRR, expansion, contraction, and renewal KPIs are defined and measured
Systems reconciliation: hands-on experience resolving data mismatches between CRM, billing, and ERP to produce a reliable single source of truth
Nice to have: experience with Salesforce and NetSuite data, or with forecasting models

Product Insights Track:

Product and usage data: experience modelling event, telemetry, or usage data, such as active usage, feature adoption, and engagement
Linking usage to business outcomes: understanding of how product behavior connects to retention, expansion, and customer health
Nice to have: experience with a product analytics tool or with IT asset, security, or infrastructure data

AI-Specific Skills

Lansweeper is an AI-native company. In this role, AI fluency is a hard requirement — not a nice-to-have.

You are expected to use AI tooling as a standard part of your day-to-day workflow: this includes AI-assisted SQL generation and debugging, using AI to accelerate data modelling and anomaly investigation, and leveraging AI features within your tech stack. You should be comfortable prompting AI tools effectively, evaluating their outputs critically, and integrating AI into repeatable workflows — from data pipeline development to drafting documentation, data tests, and lineage descriptions. General AI fluency is expected.

Team Info

You’ll join the Data & Analytics team, part of the broader Insights & Intelligence function at Lansweeper. Within the data team, you’ll collaborate daily with data analysts, data architects and fellow data engineers, so the models you build fit into a platform that is consistent and well governed.

Outside the data team, your main stakeholders will depend on your track. Revenue Analytics works closely with sales operations and finance, while Product Insights works with product management and customer success. Either way, you’ll be the link between those business teams and our data platform.

You’ll be one of two engineers joining to build out these domains, with real ownership of your area end-to-end. It’s a rare opportunity to shape how a growing SaaS company understands and steers both its revenue and its product.

The team is based across Ghent, Belgium and Alicante, Spain, with a hybrid working model at both locations.

Our Offer

Benefits — Belgium:

Meal vouchers
Eco vouchers
Hospitalisation insurance
Group insurance
Company car or mobility budget
Phone plan
Internet allowance

Benefits — Spain:

Health insurance
Meal allowance
Flexible remuneration plan

What Else You Get:

A high-impact, high-autonomy role at the intersection of data, finance, product, and go-to-market strategy
Hybrid working from either Ghent, Belgium or Alicante, Spain — flexibility built in by design
A pragmatic, collaborative data team that values ownership and real-world impact over process for process's sake
The opportunity to build the revenue and product analytics foundation of a scaling SaaS company
A front-row seat to how leadership uses data to steer the business, with your work directly influencing strategic direction

About Lansweeper

Lansweeper is the AI Cyber Asset Intelligence platform helping IT and Security teams gain full visibility, reduce cyber risk, and scale automation with confidence.

In today's complex IT, OT, cloud, and IoT environments, fragmented asset data slows decisions and increases risk. We transform raw asset data into a continuously validated, trusted source of truth — so teams can move faster and act with certainty.

With Lansweeper, Organizations Can:

See – Truly complete visibility across hybrid environments

Know – Enriched asset intelligence with lifecycle and risk context

Act – Automate workflows, coordinate remediation, and enforce policy at scale

From universal asset discovery to AI-powered intelligence, we provide the shared foundation modern IT Operations, Cybersecurity, and Digital Transformation teams rely on.

Our Culture — Built On Four Core Values:

One Team – United across boundaries
We Care – Customers and people at the centre
We Grow – Learning, sharing, improving
We Deliver – Focusing on what truly matters

Pay Transparency

At Lansweeper, every role is assigned to a level defined by three things: the expertise it requires, the complexity it involves, and the scope of impact it carries. Each level maps to a salary band based on salary benchmarks from the Software/SaaS industry of your country, so your pay reflects what the market pays for comparable roles.

Where you land within that range depends on the expertise you bring, the complexity you have navigated, the scope of impact you have owned, and your track record of delivering results in comparable roles — the same criteria applied consistently to every candidate.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, religion, ethnic origin, age, sexual orientation, or disability.

How AI Is Used During The Hiring Process

We use AI to support and not replace during the hiring process. HR decisions are made by our talent acquisition team. You can request more info at any time via [email protected]

Diversity Statement

It is Lansweeper's policy to provide equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees.

Lansweeper disapproves of, and will not tolerate, unlawful discrimination against any applicant or employee because of race, color, national origin or ancestry, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity, age, religion, disability, family care status, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
BEDRIJF:

Dit Belgische SaaS-bedrijf ontwikkelt een commercieel platform dat dagelijks door duizenden professionals wordt gebruikt en complexe operationele en financiële processen overzichtelijk maakt.

De organisatie staat aan het begin van een centralisatie naar één schaalbaar dataplatform. Waarbij data en AI een grote strategische en commerciële waarde heeft naar de verdere expansie binnen de EU.

Je komt terecht in een compact technologieteam waar je rechtstreeks samenwerkt met product en development. Het bedrijf combineert de ondernemingsmentaliteit en korte beslissingslijnen van een scale-up met de financiële slagkracht van een grotere groep. Met verdere internationale groei in het vooruitzicht krijg je de kans om mee te bepalen hoe het datalandschap van morgen eruitziet.

JOBOMSCHRIJVING:

Als Data Engineer neem je ownership over het volledige dataplatform van een groeiend SaaS-product in volle Europese expansie. Je krijgt de vrijheid om de toekomstige data-architectuur mee te bepalen, technische keuzes te maken en een schaalbaar, futureproof dataplatform uit te bouwen.

Je werkt breed en end-to-end. Je brengt databronnen samen in één centrale omgeving, bouwt schaalbare datapipelines en ontwikkelt herbruikbare datamodellen volgens een medallion architecture. Daarbij werk je met technologieën zoals Azure, Snowflake en open-sourcecomponenten.

Je kijkt verder dan de bestaande architectuur en neemt het initiatief om het datalandschap te moderniseren. Je optimaliseert processen, verhoogt de datakwaliteit en krijgt op termijn de kans om een mogelijke migratie naar Microsoft Fabric mee vorm te geven.

Wat deze rol extra interessant maakt, is dat jouw werk rechtstreeks bijdraagt aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het SaaS-product. De data-infrastructuur die je bouwt, vormt de basis voor nieuwe analyticsfunctionaliteiten waarmee klanten meer inzicht krijgen in hun eigen gegevens. Je werkt hiervoor nauw samen met developers, product owners en de business, waardoor je niet alleen technisch veel vrijheid krijgt, maar ook rechtstreeks impact hebt op de toekomst van het product.

JOUW PROFIEL:

Voor deze rol kijken we uit naar een ondernemende Data Engineer die graag ownership neemt en mee wil bouwen aan de toekomst van een groeiend platform. Je technische basis is belangrijk, maar vooral je persoonlijkheid, initiatief en zin voor ownership maken het verschil.

Concreet breng je mee:

2 à 3 jaar ervaring met Data Engineering.
Goede kennis van Python en SQL.
Ervaring met het bouwen en onderhouden van datapipelines en datamodellen.
Ervaring met cloudomgevingen, idealiter Azure en/of Snowflake.
Interesse in data-architectuur.
Je bent ondernemend, denkt proactief mee en durft zelfstandig technische keuzes te maken.
Je neemt ownership, communiceert vlot en voelt je thuis in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt.
Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands.

UNIEK KARAKTER:

Je combineert de ondernemersmentaliteit van een scale-up met de financiële slagkracht van een sterke investeringsgroep. Het bedrijf staat aan het begin van een nieuwe groeifase, met grote ambities binnen Europa en volop ruimte om het dataplatform verder uit te bouwen.

Je komt niet terecht in een omgeving waar alle technische keuzes en processen al vastliggen. Integendeel, je krijgt de vrijheid om te experimenteren, initiatief te nemen en zelf richting te geven aan de toekomstige data-architectuur. Dankzij de korte beslissingslijnen kun je ideeën ook snel omzetten in concrete oplossingen.

Bovendien bouw je mee aan een SaaS-product in een sector met een enorm digitaliseringspotentieel. De nauwe samenwerking met product en business zorgt ervoor dat je rechtstreeks inspeelt op de noden van klanten. Zo zie je jouw technische werk vertaald worden naar slimmere systemen, nieuwe functionaliteiten en tastbare impact op het product

jobs.title: Data Engineer - Power BI Specialist
jobs.description:
Who is DESOTEC?

DESOTEC, founded in 1990, is the leading provider of mobile filtration solutions in Europe
and has been building a strong and growing presence in the United States
since 2023. Thanks to its unique, flexible, circular service concept
and the extensive expertise built up over many decades, DESOTEC unburdens its industrial customers and helps industries grow and thrive while reducing the environmental impact of their operations.

DESOTEC's customer base is constantly growing thanks to a strong focus on 24/7 service and a commitment to design and deliver the best purification solution in close dialogue with the customer. DESOTEC has about 450 employees
worldwide
, all committed to helping protect the planet by driving positive ecological change
across industries. In 2026, DESOTEC earned its second consecutive EcoVadis Gold
rating for sustainability, placing it among the top 5% of companies assessed worldwide.

Further information is available at www.desotec.com. Follow @desotec on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram

Your tasks & responsibilities?

At DESOTEC, we are on an ambitious growth journey, expanding internationally and scaling our operations across multiple markets. As data becomes increasingly critical in driving smart decisions, operational excellence and innovation, we are currently looking for a Data Engineer to help build and maintain the foundations of our data ecosystem. You will develop scalable data solutions, ensure reliable data availability across the organization and contribute to transforming data into actionable insights. This is a unique opportunity to leave your mark on a fast-growing, purpose-driven international company.

Power BI Platform & Architecture Approach: You help shape and support a scalable Power BI platform, ensuring that reporting solutions are built on trusted data, well-structured semantic models and clear governance principles. You contribute to the evolution of the data architecture by aligning Power BI datasets, dataflows and reporting standards with business needs, security requirements and long-term maintainability. You actively support a future-proof BI environment that enables both reliable management reporting and controlled self-service analytics across the organization.
Business Intelligence Enablement: You work closely with business stakeholders, IT colleagues and reporting experts to understand data requirements and translate them into sustainable technical solutions to maximize reporting effectiveness.
Data Modeling & Integration: You design, build and maintain robust data models that support business intelligence and analytics use cases. You manage data transformations and integration logic, ensuring consistency and efficiency across the data landscape.
Data Quality & Reliability: You monitor and improve data quality, integrity and performance across the entire data platform. You proactively identify and resolve issues to guarantee trustworthy and decision-ready data.

Who are you?

You hold a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g. Data, IT, Engineering, Computer Science or similar).
You are highly proficient in Englishand can communicate effectively with colleagues, stakeholders and leadership teams across our local and international operations. Knowledge of Dutch is considered a strong advantage.
You bring solid experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar data-focused role, working with modern data platforms and integration technologies.
You possess strong SQL expertise and have experience developing, optimizing and troubleshooting complex data solutions.
You have hands-on experience with Azure Data Platform technologies, Data Lakes, ETL/ELT processes and data modeling.
You are familiar with Power BI and/or Microsoft Fabric and understand the backend principles required to support performant and scalable reporting environments.
You have a solid understanding of data architecture principles and know how to build solutions that are scalable, robust and maintainable.
You have a strong focus on data quality, reliability and performance, and take pride in delivering stable and efficient data solutions.
You are a hands-on technical specialist who enjoys solving complex problems and working collaboratively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You communicate clearly and work effectively with colleagues across business and IT functions to deliver impactful data solutions.

If you can't tick off all the boxes, but you do recognize yourself in our three core values Teamwork, Excellence and Devotion, then we definitely invite you to take a chance and apply!

What does your team look like?

As a Data Engineer
, you will be part of DESOTEC's growing data organization and work closely together with data and reporting professionals. You will report to our Data Lead and collaborate closely with BI developers, business stakeholders and IT teams to build and maintain a reliable and future-proof data ecosystem.

You operate at Group level, supporting multiple countries and entities, and play a key role in ensuring data is readily available, reliable and scalable across the organization.

What's in it for you?

It goes without saying that you get a lot in return in exchange for your unbridled dedication and enthusiasm:

A competitive salary: We guarantee you a (more than) competitive base salary, depending on your experience.
Fringe benefits: To optimize your salary package, you can count on: a company car with charging card, a smartphone with a mobile subscription, a generous net expense reimbursement, meal vouchers, group and hospitalization insurance (AG Insurance), a non-recurrent CAO90 bonus, two annual gross bonuses, and the option for bicycle leasing after 6 months of service.
Flexible compensation plan: You can convert part of your end-of-year bonus into benefits that suit your lifestyle, such as extra leave, multimedia, or a lease bike. This gives you the freedom to take control of your reward package and personalize it in a way that truly works for you, all within the applicable legal framework.
Work-life-balance / hybrid working: You work during flexible hours and get the freedom to spend 2 days a week in your home office after a training period. This flexible working arrangement allows you to start your workday in a relaxed manner, avoiding the morning rush, and to enjoy a high level of autonomy.
Time off to schedule freely: At DESOTEC there is no collective closure. You enjoy 29 paid vacation days and have the freedom to take 10 unpaid vacation days on top of that. This way you can increase your number of vacation days to 39 days!
Personal & professional growth: You will have every opportunity to immerse yourself in your new role, but also to grow personally and professionally through an extensive range of training courses.
Stay active & social: As an employee with a permanent contract, you can enjoy one free group sport lesson/activity per week at the Vision 21 gym in Roeselare, including activities like boxing, pilates, spinning, padel and more.
Discounts through partnerships: Through Benefits at Work you get discounts at Center Parcs, Zalando, bol.com, Krëfel, Decathlon and many more.
Fun and relaxation: You will regularly be invited to one of the many afterworks and other fun activities. Each team also gets a team building budget – it's up to you how you spend it!
Structured onboarding: We prepare a tailored onboarding plan for every new starter, ensuring a smooth integration into your team, tools, and DESOTEC’s mission from day one.

About Us

Our purpose and mission?

At DESOTEC, we are committed to building a cleaner, greener world for all
. We strive to helping protect the planet by driving positive ecological change across all industries. Witness our mission with your own eyes in the DESOTEC purpose movie.

Watch our company video to discover our culture, meet the team, and see what makes our workplace unique.

Binnen de infrastructuurwerking wordt verder gebouwd aan een centraal analytisch dataplatform op basis van Microsoft Fabric, met focus op de verrijking en ontsluiting van infrastructuur-, patrimonium- en assetdata. Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van data pipelines voor een analytisch dataplatform.
Ontwerpen en implementeren van ETL-processen voor het verwerken en structureren van data.
Uitwerken van datamodellen en datawarehouse-structuren, waaronder stermodellen en dimensies.
Bouwen van rapporten en dashboards in Power BI, met aandacht voor performantie en gebruiksvriendelijkheid.
Integreren van databronnen via onder meer databanken en REST APIs.
Werken binnen Microsoft Fabric of een Azure data stack en bijdragen aan een schaalbaar dataplatform.
Bewaken van datakwaliteit, data-governance en securityprincipes binnen de oplossing.

jobs.title: Cloud & Data engineer
jobs.description:
Jouw functie

Breng je nieuwsgierigheid mee naar het werk als onze volgende Cloud & Data Engineer
. Je wordt onderdeel van ons gespecialiseerde softwareteam binnen Atlas Copco Airpower in Wilrijk en rapporteert aan de team leader. In deze functie is het jouw missie om als brug te fungeren tussen software engineering, data engineering en toegepaste data science, en om schaalbare cloudbackends, streaming datapiplines en AI-gedreven diagnostische tools te bouwen die duizenden verbonden industriële compressoren wereldwijd optimaliseren.

Jouw dagelijkse werkzaamheden

Bouwen en schalen van het cloudplatform dat fysieke machinecontrollers in het veld verbindt met intelligente cloudservices voor vlootmonitoring, voorspellend onderhoud (predictive maintenance) en diagnostische inzichten.
Vloeibaar schakelen tussen het opzetten van streaming telemetriepipelines (Azure Data Explorer, Databricks, Event Hubs) en het ontwikkelen van machine learning-modellen voor anomaliedetectie en voorspelling van storingen.
Uitrollen van ML-modellen naar productie met driftmonitoring, schrijven van Infrastructure-as-Code (Bicep), bouwen van backend API's (C# / Python) en uitbreiden van agentic AI- en RAG-architecturen voor ongestructureerde technische kennis.
Nauw samenwerken met een multidisciplinair team van engineers en onderzoekers om ideeën via notebookprototypes en CI/CD-pipelines om te zetten in betrouwbare, productijpe services.
Deelnemen aan code reviews, technische afstemming en continue verbeterinitiatieven binnen het softwareteam.

Jouw vaardigheden en ervaring

Masterdiploma in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence of een aanverwant vakgebied (of gelijkwaardig door praktijkervaring).
1 tot 3 jaar hands-on ervaring in software engineering, datapiplelines en machine learning workflows.
Solide programmeervaardigheden in Python; werkende kennis van C# of de leergierigheid om dit snel op te pikken.
Praktische ervaring met cloudplatforms (bij voorkeur Azure), MLOps-tools (bijv. MLflow, Weights & Biases) en tijdreeksdataverwerking (ADX/Kusto, Spark, Databricks, SQL).
Vertrouwdheid met LLM-toepassingen, prompt engineering, RAG-architecturen, vector databanken en agentic frameworks (bijv. LangChain, Semantic Kernel).
Ervaring met moderne software engineering praktijken: Git, CI/CD, containerisering, Infrastructure-as-Code (Bicep) en code reviews; kennis van IoT-protocollen (MQTT, AMQP) of frontend frameworks is een pluspunt.
Nieuwsgierige, pragmatische en samenwerkingsgerichte instelling met een professionele beheersing van het Engels (mondeling en schriftelijk).

We moedigen je aan om te solliciteren, ook als je niet aan alle vereisten voldoet. We waarderen uiteenlopende ervaringen en perspectieven en zijn benieuwd wat jij meebrengt naar de functie.

Jouw beloning en arbeidsvoorwaarden

Bij Atlas Copco Group zetten we ons in voor een eerlijke en gelijkwaardige beloning. De beloning wordt bepaald op basis van de functie en de bijbehorende verantwoordelijkheden, zonder onderscheid naar gender, ras, etniciteit, religie, fysieke mogelijkheden, seksuele geaardheid, burgerlijke staat of enig ander beschermd kenmerk. Ons beloningsaanbod is ontworpen om lokaal relevant, competitief en afgestemd te zijn op de verwachtingen van huidig en toekomstig talent.

Het daadwerkelijke beloningspakket wordt bepaald op basis van objectieve, genderneutrale criteria, waaronder maar niet beperkt tot de kwalificaties, ervaring en vaardigheden die tijdens het wervingsproces worden aangetoond. Naast het basissalaris omvat deze functie een uitgebreid onboardingprogramma, inclusief begeleiding door een persoonlijke peter of meter. Je krijgt ook toegang tot wereldwijde carrièremogelijkheden als onderdeel van de Atlas Copco Group. Wij bieden een interessant pakket aan beloningen en secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder een ziekteverzekering, betaald verlof en pensioenvoorzieningen.

Naast beloning geloven we dat een waardevolle loopbaan draait om kansen om te leren, te groeien, bij te dragen en je te ontwikkelen in een omgeving die is gebouwd op vertrouwen, samenwerking en continue verbetering. Bij Atlas Copco Group ondersteunen we onze mensen bij het opbouwen van een duurzame loopbaan, terwijl ze met hun werk een betekenisvolle impact maken.

Jouw werklocatie

Deze functie biedt een hybride werkmodel, waarbij je je tijd kunt verdelen tussen werken op afstand en werken op locatie bij onze site in Wilrijk, België.

Waarom het fijn is om bij ons te werken

Je carrière groeit door je vaardigheden, je nieuwsgierigheid en de mensen met wie je samenwerkt. Je maakt deel uit van een wereldwijd netwerk waarin we van elkaar leren en kennis delen. We richten ons op ontwikkeling op de lange termijn en moedigen je aan om nieuwe ideeën te verkennen die ons vooruithelpen. Innovatie is ingebed in hoe we denken en handelen – we testen, verbeteren en gebruiken wat we leren om oplossingen te creëren die een verschil maken. Met jouw ideeën en verantwoordelijkheid kan jij impact maken. Wij ondersteunen jou met een flexibel arbeidsmodel en goed leiderschap.

Selectieproces

Ons selectieproces bestaat uit verschillende gesprekken en, voor sommige functies, vaardigheidstests die ons helpen om jouw profiel beter te begrijpen. We kijken er alvast naar uit om je te leren kennen, om meer te horen over jouw sterke punten en te bespreken hoe onze samenwerking eruit kan zien .

Uniting Curious Minds

Achter elke innovatie zitten mensen die samenwerken om de toekomst vorm te geven. Met carrières die bruisen van initiatief en levenslang leren, brengen wij curious minds samen en jij kan één van hen zijn.

jobs.title: Data Engineer (H/F)
jobs.description:
SMILE
est le leader du "sourire" au travail, mais aussi de l'intégration de solutions Open-Source
. Enthousiastes, agiles et performants, notre vocation est de libérer le potentiel d'innovation des entreprises, à travers l'Open-Source !

Nos Smiliens experts accompagnent les entreprises dans des domaines aussi variés que le Digital, les Business Apps, l'Embarqué & l'IoT et l'Infrastructure : 2000 collaborateurs présents dans 9 pays, avec 17 agences réparties en France et à l'international. Nos marques expertes : SensioLabs, Neopixl, Alter Way, UX-Republic, Creativestyle et Synotis.

Nous sommes certifiés “Happy at Work” 2023 !😍

Au sein de l'agence située à Casablanca, rejoignez une équipe dynamique de passionnés du monde Open Source, dans une ambiance à taille humaine.

Nous cherchons un(e) Data Engineer qui peut nous aider à évaluer la qualité, l'exactitude et l'exhaustivité des sources de données et des produits numériques.

Vos responsabilités :

Concevoir, développer et maintenir des pipelines de données robustes et scalables.
Intégrer et transformer des données issues de sources multiples (APIs, bases de

données, fichiers, systèmes tiers).

Optimiser la performance et la qualité des flux de données (monitoring, logging,

gestion des erreurs).

Mettre en place des mécanismes de gestion de la qualité et de la sécurité des données.
Participer à la conception de l’architecture Data (stockage, ingestion, transformation,

restitution).

Implémenter et administrer des solutions Cloud/Data Warehouse (Snowflake, Azure

Blob Storage, etc.).

Automatiser les workflows de données avec des orchestrateurs (Airflow, dbt, etc.).
Travailler étroitement avec les Data Scientists et Analystes pour rendre les données

prêtes à l’analyse.

Contribuer à l’intégration des modèles de Machine Learning et d’analyses avancées

dans les pipelines.

Documenter et partager les bonnes pratiques d’ingénierie des données au sein de

l’équipe.

Environnement technique:

Langages & outils de traitement de données : Python, SQL (DBT), Spark, Bash.
Orchestration & ETL : expérience avec Airflow ou outils similaires.
Bases de données : maîtrise des systèmes relationnels et NoSQL.
Cloud & Data Warehouse : expérience avec Snowflake, Azure (Blob Storage), ou équivalent.
Visualisation : la maîtrise de Power BI est un plus.
Maitrise des outils de CI/CD/Git
Connaissances des environnements Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) est un atout.
Bonne compréhension des architectures orientées données (Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Data Mesh).

Qualifications :

Vous avez un Bac+5 en Data Science, Statistiques, Informatique ou un domaine similaire.
Vous avez 2 ans d'expérience en analyse, gestion et/ou qualité de la donnée.
Vous avez des excellentes capacités d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes.
Vous avez une autonomie et capacité à travailler sur des projets complexes.
Vous avez un esprit d’équipe et bonnes compétences en communication.

Envoyez-nous vite votre CV, ce poste est pour vous !

jobs.location: Le Mans, Pays de la Loire, France
jobs.description:
Le Groupe SII vous attend !

Nous recherchons un Développeur Talend Big Data (H/F) chez SII Le Mans.

Missions et responsabilités

Contribuez à l’évolution et au maintien en conditions opérationnelles de solutions de traitement de données. Vous interviendrez de l’analyse des besoins à la mise en production, dans un environnement associant Talend, SQL et les technologies Big Data.

Analyser les spécifications fonctionnelles et rédiger les spécifications techniques nécessaires aux développements.
Implémenter de nouvelles fonctionnalités et développer les flux d’intégration de données avec Talend.
Concevoir et optimiser les requêtes SQL pour améliorer les performances des traitements.
Participer aux recettes techniques et fonctionnelles, analyser les anomalies et mettre en œuvre les corrections.
Assurer la maintenance et le support des solutions déployées.
Prendre en charge les activités de RUN dans un environnement SQL, Spark, Hive, Cloudera, Java, HBase et Talend : suivre les traitements, diagnostiquer les incidents et contribuer à leur résolution.
Rédiger et maintenir la documentation technique pour faciliter l’exploitation, la maintenance et le partage des connaissances.

Profil recherché

Vous maîtrisez Talend pour concevoir et faire évoluer des flux de données, ainsi que SQL pour écrire et optimiser des requêtes.
Vous connaissez les environnements Big Data intégrant Spark, Hive, Cloudera et HBase, et possédez des compétences en Java.
Vous savez traduire des besoins fonctionnels en spécifications techniques et en développements testables.

Vous êtes curieux techniquement, vous avez le sens de la rigueur et du service.
