jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer - Financial Services
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

EY Belgium Data team supports our clients in defining and rolling out the right data architecture, data platform and infrastructure that support their needs, implement and maintain automated data pipelines, and infuse data through business intelligence and analytics. We are currently looking for capable and motivated professionals to join our team as Data Engineer.

Your Key Responsibilities

As Data Engineer, you will do:

Data Pipeline Development: Design, build, and maintain robust data pipelines using modern tools like Databricks, dbt, … to facilitate efficient ETL/ELT processes.
Data Migration: Lead and execute data migration projects, ensuring seamless transition of data from legacy systems to new cloud-based platforms while maintaining data integrity and quality.
Cloud Platform Management: Set up, configure, and manage cloud-based data platforms (e.g., databricks, snowflake, azure) to support data storage, processing, and analytics.
Collaboration with Stakeholders: Work closely with business stakeholders to understand data requirements, provide insights, and ensure alignment between data engineering efforts and business objectives.
DataOps Implementation: Implement DataOps practices to enhance collaboration between data engineering and operations teams, ensuring continuous integration and delivery of data solutions.
Technology Exploration: Stay updated with the latest technologies and trends in data engineering, evaluating and integrating new tools and frameworks (e.g., dbt, Python libraries) to improve data processing and analytics.
Performance Optimization: Monitor and optimize data pipelines and processes for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness in cloud environments.
Documentation and Best Practices: Maintain comprehensive documentation of data workflows, architecture, and best practices to ensure knowledge sharing and compliance with data governance standards.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and other IT teams to ensure that data solutions meet analytical needs and support business intelligence initiatives.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Master’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or another relevant subject.
Minimum 2 Years Experience: Proven experience in data engineering roles, demonstrating a solid understanding of data modeling and platform building.
Proficient in Python and Coding: Practical experience with Python or other programming languages, enabling the development of data pipelines and automation scripts.
Database Technologies Expertise: Familiarity with various database technologies (e.g., SQL, NoSQL) to effectively manage and manipulate data.
Cloud Technologies Knowledge: Experience with Azure and Databricks is a significant advantage, showcasing the ability to work with modern cloud-based data platforms.
SQL Proficiency: Strong SQL skills are essential for querying and managing relational databases, ensuring efficient data retrieval and manipulation.
Client-Facing Experience: Ability to interact with clients and stakeholders, understanding their needs and translating them into technical solutions.
Collaborative Team Player: Experience working collaboratively within a team environment, contributing to collective goals and supporting team members.
Strong Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex data concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Proactive Attitude: A "go-getter" mentality, demonstrating initiative and a willingness to tackle challenges and drive projects forward.
Language Proficiency: Fluency in Dutch or French, along with proficient business English, to effectively communicate with diverse stakeholders and clients.

What We Offer You

You will be part of a leading global professional services firm.
You will be part of the EY family where everyone is willing to offer support and senior management is very accessible.
You will join a dynamic and growing team with a great mix of young and experienced professionals focusing on financial services.
You will get extensive trainings on technical matters, as well as soft skills and project management, and you will have access to new technologies and innovative equipment.
We are proud of our flexible working arrangements, and we will support you to build a successful career and deliver excellent client service, without sacrificing your personal priorities.
While our client-facing profession might require part-time working at client site and business traveling at times, we are committed to helping you achieve a lifestyle balance.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

adesso Belgium, who are we?
We are an IT (start-up) provider working under the adesso umbrella with a proven track record in different industries. The new Belgian entity of adesso
is part of the expansion and growth strategy of the adesso group. With more than 12,000 employees spread over 70 locations, we are entering an exciting period with our presence in Brussels, the capital of Europe.

At adesso Belgium, we combine the entrepreneurial energy
of a growing local organisation
with the expertise
and reach
of an international technology group
. Our Data & AI practice helps clients turn data into measurable value by designing and delivering secure, scalable and production-ready platforms.

Job Requirements

Your role

As Lead Data Engineering Architect
, you will be a senior technical leader and trusted advisor for our clients. You will combine architecture expertise, hands-on engineering know-how and delivery leadership to help our customers design, build and evolve modern data platforms.

Working closely with the Practice Lead and a growing team of consultants, you will play a key role in shaping delivery success, guiding technical decisions, mentoring engineers and supporting the continued growth of our Data & AI practice in Belgium.

You will lead architecture and delivery activities across multiple client engagements, act as a trusted technical counterpart for stakeholders, and help translate business objectives into scalable, secure and production-ready data platform solutions.

As the practice continues to grow, you will have the opportunity to progressively expand your responsibilities in areas such as client development, pre-sales, recruitment, coaching and practice leadership.

participate the end-to-end delivery of Data Platform & Engineering engagements, from initial scoping through kick-off, onboarding, execution, steering, quality assurance and closure of the delivery.
Act as the primary technical contact for clients, building trusted relationships with delivery stakeholders, sponsors and decision-makers.
Coordinate between one and four engagements, maintaining clear priorities, delivery plans, dependencies, risks, decisions and escalation paths.
Take ownership of scope and architecture decisions, with broader staffing and delivery choices made in close collaboration with the Practice Lead.
Lead operational steering meetings, communicate progress transparently and manage technical issues, delays, consultant transitions and scope changes.
Safeguard delivery quality through architecture reviews, engineering standards, technical assessments and hands-on quality checks.
Identify follow-on opportunities within existing engagements and bring them to Sales and the Practice Lead without compromising delivery focus.

Present and defend proposed solutions with clients, supported by the Practice Lead where appropriate.

Help shape recruitment priorities and support the certification and competence development of consultants.
Represent the practice credibly in client discussions and, over time, contribute to reusable assets, delivery standards, partner activities and the evolution of the Data Platform offering.

Your profile

Must have

9+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Cloud Data Platforms, Data Architecture or Technology Consulting.
Strong expertise in Microsoft Azure and Databricks, with experience delivering modern cloud-based data platforms.
Solid hands-on experience with Python, PySpark and modern data engineering practices.
Experience designing and delivering scalable, secure and maintainable data solutions in enterprise environments.
Ability to translate business requirements into architecture decisions and practical delivery plans.
Experience interacting directly with clients, leading workshops and communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Proven ability to coach, mentor or guide engineering teams.
Professional fluency in English and native proficiency in either French or Dutch.
Willingness to work with clients across Belgium and collaborate regularly with the Brussels-based team.

Experience with Microsoft Fabric and/or Snowflake.
Experience with Terraform, Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD practices.
Knowledge of DataOps, DevOps, cloud security, governance, observability or FinOps.
Experience leading delivery teams or coordinating multiple parallel workstreams.
Experience supporting pre-sales activities, solution design or effort estimation.
Experience in consulting environments and customer-facing delivery organizations.
Familiarity with Agile delivery frameworks such as Scrum, SAFe or PRINCE2.
Microsoft, Databricks or other relevant cloud certifications.

Vous appliquez les bonnes pratiques de développement (tests, revue de code, patterns de conception, gestion des erreurs) et contribuez à l’industrialisation des traitements.

Vous contribuez à la standardisation des pratiques de développement data (patterns, templates, guidelines) au sein du pôle Data.
Vous participez aux revues de code, aux échanges de bonnes pratiques et aux séances de partage (démos, communautés de pratique, veille technologique).
Vous faites preuve de pédagogie et êtes capable d’expliquer vos choix techniques aux autres membres de l’équipe, y compris non techniques.

Vous disposez de 5 à 8 années d’expérience en environnement data / IT, dont une expérience solide en data engineering.
Vous maîtrisez les concepts et outils de data engineering dans des environnements proches de :
Azure
Snowflake ou autre data warehouse cloud,
dbt ou outils équivalents de transformation et de gestion de modèles,
Python (scripts, ETL, traitements de données),
SQL (modélisation, optimisation de requêtes, manipulation de données).

Vous avez une expérience concrète dans la mise en place ou l’amélioration de plateformes data et de solutions de Business Intelligence (par ex. Power BI, Tableau, Qlik…).

Compétences fonctionnelles et comportementales

Vous avez le sens du détail et de la qualité technique, et êtes à l’aise avec les problématiques de performance, robustesse et fiabilité.
Vous êtes capable de comprendre les besoins métiers et de les traduire en spécifications techniques claires.
Vous accordez une importance particulière à la qualité des données, à la sécurité, à la documentation et au respect du RGPD.

Vous faites preuve de rigueur, d’initiative et de capacité à proposer des améliorations sur les solutions existantes.

Langues

Vous maîtrisez l’anglais à l’écrit et à l’oral, vous permettant de consulter de la documentation, d’échanger avec des équipes internationales et de documenter vos réalisations.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Measurement & Reporting
jobs.description:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform
that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe.
With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About The Role

Vibe ingests more than 500,000 messages a second and stores several petabytes. Every advertiser who opens their dashboard expects their campaign numbers to be right, and current. You own the layer that makes that true. The platform side of the team builds the storage and compute. You run production on top of it: schema changes, data transformations, the reporting pipeline that feeds the client-facing UI. At this volume that is not maintenance work. A schema change is a distributed systems problem. A slow query is a customer-facing incident. We are already past what off-the-shelf systems handle, which is why this is a senior seat and not a junior one.

You get production ownership from week one, direct access to the engineers who built the infrastructure underneath you, and problems that don't have a Stack Overflow answer.

What You'll Do

Ship schema changes across petabyte-scale tables without breaking downstream consumers or advertiser reporting
Make the reporting stack faster and cheaper. ClickHouse and Cube serve the client UI, so query latency and compute spend are yours to defend
Turn new product features into production data models, from raw Kafka and Iceberg through to what the advertiser sees
Trace discrepancies back through the stack to the source system, then fix the cause instead of the symptom
Catch scaling and data-quality problems before they page someone at 2am
Push back when a request costs more than it's worth. "Not yet" and "not this way" are answers we expect to hear from you

What You Need

5+ years in production data engineering. You have owned pipelines real users depended on, with on-call attached
Strong SQL and schema design at a volume where the design choice actually mattered
Production experience with an orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect) plus dbt or an equivalent transformation framework
One optimization win you can walk us through end to end: what was slow or expensive, what you changed, what the number went from and to, and why it worked
Systems-level depth. Our technical round is the team drilling into how things work underneath, not a puzzle screen
The judgment to turn a vague request into a concrete plan, and the comfort to do it fast

Nice to Haves

ClickHouse in production, or another column store at serious scale (Druid, Pinot, BigQuery) with real war stories about partitioning, materialized views, or merge behaviour
Kafka or another streaming system feeding a serving layer, not just nightly batch
AdTech or programmatic background

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

The pay range for this role is €93,000–€142,000. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You're building this; you should own part of it.
Variable pay — based on objectives you hit. No arbitrary targets.
Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!
Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.
Meal vouchers — Via Swile.
Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.
Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting.

Recruiter screen — 30 min with a recruiter. We'll share context; you'll share yours.
Manager interview — 45 min with the hiring manager. Experience deep-dive and judgment, not a technical grilling.
Technical interview — 90 min with the engineering team. No LeetCode, no from-scratch coding. Expect a hands-on, practical exercise, with the exact format tailored to your background.
Bar raiser — 30 min with our CTO and Cofounder. A final read on how you think and why Vibe.
Offer — Fast. We don't let good decisions sit.

Equal Opportunity

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Referral Instructions

Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf.

Rejoindre Davidson, ce n’est pas seulement intégrer un groupe de 3000 consultants dans 6 pays et 2 continents, c’est intégrer LA société qui a été élue par ses salariés Great Place To Work France et Europe pendant 4 ans mais aussi une des plus grandes B Corp de France, nommée Best of the World dans la catégorie “collaborateurs” en 2022 ! (Les “B Corp” formant une communauté de sociétés qui ont décidé d’être non pas les meilleures du monde mais les meilleures POUR le monde).

Parce que notre développement repose sur des principes forts :

Un profond respect de l’ensemble de nos parties prenantes : consultant(e)s, clients et fournisseurs. Car si le travail “ne fait pas le bonheur”, il peut cependant “faire le malheur”. Nous nous engageons donc à écouter et agir avec honnêteté.
Une égalité des chances dans le traitement de nos candidatures et dans la gestion de carrière de nos salarié(e)s. Nous croyons en un milieu de travail où équité F/H, inclusion et diversité sont la norme.
Une empreinte environnementale minimale, et sociétale maximale. C’est pourquoi, au-delà des missions que vous réaliserez, vous pourrez également contribuer à des projets que Davidson soutient : missions de solidarité internationale (avec Planète Urgence), bénévolat auprès d’associations (chaque Davidsonien(ne) dispose de 3 jours par an pour intervenir à leurs côtés), accompagnement d’étudiant(e)s issus de milieux peu favorisés (avec Article 1), investissement dans des startups développant des solutions innovantes, actions collectives et individuelles pour la réduction de notre impact carbone…
Un Management adhocratique basé sur la mise en œuvre des principes de “l’entreprise horizontale” et du “management tribal”. Sur ce dernier point une précision d’importance : le bien-être au travail est un luxe qu’il faut pouvoir s’offrir en étant une entreprise “solide”. Ceci induit pour les Davidsonien(ne)s d’allier prises d’initiative, engagement et professionnalisme. Car “sans travail, le talent n’est qu’une sale manie”. Et cela nous incite à chercher à recruter des personnes… meilleures que nous…

Nous encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap, et nous nous engageons à répondre au mieux à leurs besoins spécifiques.

Profil / Mission

Contexte

Mission au sein d’un programme stratégique de transformation data et IA dans un grand groupe bancaire.
Objectif : moderniser la Data Platform AWS afin d’alimenter des solutions d’IA (dont IA générative) et améliorer l’exploitation des données clients et ESG.

Périmètre

Intervention sur le stream Data Platform (AWS Cloud), en production depuis 2022, avec des enjeux d’industrialisation, de performance et de sécurité.

Missions

Définition et évolution de l’architecture Data Lake / Lakehouse
Développement et industrialisation des pipelines de données
Implémentation de solutions de data management AWS
Mise en place des process CI/CD
Contribution à un Data Lab
Traduction des besoins métier en solutions techniques
Participation aux mises en production et support en cas d’incident majeur

Compétences requises ou à acquérir
Environnement technique

AWS (services data)
PySpark (AWS Glue)
Java (API)
GitHub / Copilot
CI/CD

Profil

5+ ans d’expérience en Data Engineering
Forte expertise Data Management
Expérience Cloud AWS significative
Contexte data volumétrique et critique
Anglais professionnel obligatoire

Autonomie
Bon relationnel
Réactivité
Force de proposition
Dynamisme
Savoir bien communiquer

jobs.title: Data Engineering Manager (F/H)
jobs.description:
Drawing on more than 115 years of Japanese expertise, Brother designs and delivers products, solutions and services for printing and document management. With its proprietary technologies and a culture centred on close customer relationships, the Group supports businesses in meeting their transformation challenges, today and in the future.
From printing and scanning to labelling and traceability, Brother provides reliability, performance and value-added services to anticipate and meet its customers’ needs.
Operating in 44 countries with nearly 40,000 employees, the Group remains true to its “At Your Side”
promise, placing customer satisfaction and innovation at the heart of its mission.

Looking for a meaningful career in a stimulating environment? Join Brother and help us build the future!

Job description

The Data & Insight team at Brother International Europe supports European operations across three pillars: Data Engineering, Insights and Data Governance.
As our team grows, we are looking for a Data Engineering Manager to strengthen coordination, delivery quality and the development of robust, scalable data pipelines. The role combines day-to-day management, team development and hands-on technical contributions to key initiatives.
This role goes beyond senior architecture expertise: we are looking for someone who can organise the team’s work, improve Data Engineering practices and ensure more reliable delivery.

Your main responsibilities will include:
Coordinate day-to-day Data Engineering activities, including prioritisation, progress tracking, delivery quality and stakeholder communication.
Manage and support a team of data engineers across several European markets.
Contribute to the design, development and improvement of data pipelines using our Snowflake, Matillion and Snowpipe stack.
Participate in technical reviews to improve code quality, documentation, maintainability and pipeline reliability.
Collaborate with Insights, Data Governance, IT and business stakeholders to translate requirements into clear, practical data solutions.
Help establish best practices for development, testing, monitoring and incident management.
Support team members in developing their technical skills and autonomy.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of our data platform and the progressive standardisation and scaling of Data Engineering practices.

Qualifications :

We are looking for someone with solid experience (at least five years) in Data Engineering, Data Platforms or data pipeline development, alongside initial experience in people management, technical coordination or mentoring junior colleagues.
You should be able to contribute technically to key initiatives, organise the team’s work and collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders across Europe.

Required skills :

Excellent SQL skills and a good working knowledge of Python for developing and optimising data pipelines.
Experience with modern cloud data environments, ideally Snowflake, and ELT/ETL tools such as dbt, Airflow, Matillion or equivalent.
Strong skills in designing, maintaining and improving data pipelines, with particular attention to quality, monitoring and documentation.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and work effectively in an international environment.
Good understanding of BI/reporting ecosystems and enterprise systems, including ERP, CRM, SAP and Salesforce.
Ability to work with business teams to translate their requirements into relevant data solutions.
Fluency in English.

Join us and enjoy a rewarding working environment!

French cadre employment status.
Personal protection insurance and supplementary health cover.
Profit-sharing, performance-related incentive schemes and employee savings plans.
Meal vouchers.
Social activities organised by the Social and Economic Committee (CSE).
Hybrid working arrangements: two days of remote work per week.
A structured onboarding programme to help you settle into your role.
A quiet, pleasant workspace with free parking nearby.

Brother France is committed to inclusion, values diversity and considers all applications fairly, without discrimination.

Why join us?

Workplace wellbeing:
Brother France is Great Place to Work® certified, recognising our commitment to wellbeing, trust and professional fulfilment. We support every employee’s ongoing skills development. You will work in an atmosphere of trust, with a pleasant working environment and a supportive management culture.

A close-knit team and supportive working environment:
You will benefit from an environment that encourages initiative, participation in decision-making and autonomy. We provide the conditions for you to make the most of your talents and abilities. You will also take part in our annual company convention, bringing together employees from across France.

Challenging work and engaging industries:
We offer exciting opportunities and responsibilities through assignments that provide meaningful challenges. Our employee awards programme recognises and rewards contributions.
Our customers operate in industries shaping the future, including new technologies and innovation, giving you opportunities to broaden your knowledge and grow personally.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer Snowflake
jobs.description:
Can’t wait to make an impact on the world?

You’re not alone. We strongly believe that data and the intelligent use of it hold a lot of potential for making an impact that matters to our clients, our people and society.

Join us in making this impact!

Your journey with us

The life of a Senior Data Engin eer is very diverse. From implementing, code reviewing, and debugging data pipelines to leading large teams in complex data migrations for our clients.

Your role and tasks can switch frequently depending on the project at hand, meaning that one day you might be building a data warehouse and the next you are assisting our cloud team with providing the right information for the ideal setup for a large data platform.

You will be the key link between Deloitte leadership, Client leadership, your own technical team and both the technical & business teams at the client.

Internally you will leverage your knowledge & experience to bring your fellow data engineers to the next level, while also build PoC’s accelerators that will help our clients in getting the most out of their data.

Key Responsibilities

Designing, implementing and maintaining Snowflake data platforms on Azure and/or AWS, integrated with the surrounding cloud services (storage, orchestration, identity, BI).
Connecting heterogeneous source systems — ERP, CRM, operational, financial and third-party data — into a governed central platform.
Translating business requirements into technical solutions, and challenging them where a simpler or more scalable design exists.
Data modelling: creating a conceptual model and translating it into a logical and physical one.
Building and optimizing ELT/ETL data flows (SQL, dbt, Snowpark, Python) and tuning warehouse cost and performance.
Implementing platform security on Snowflake: RBAC role hierarchies, authentication and SSO, masking and row access policies, data classification.
Enabling AI and GenAI use cases on the platform — Snowflake Cortex, vector search / RAG patterns, and the data foundations that make them work.
Contributing to client workshops, architecture design sessions and deliverables, with growing autonomy.
Supporting proposals and contributing to internal assets, accelerators and knowledge sharing.

Let's Talk About You

You have 2–3 years of hands-on experience in data engineering or data platform work;
You have solid hands-on Snowflake experience and hold a Snowflake certification, or are willing to obtain SnowPro Core within your first months with us;
You are strong in SQL and comfortable writing Python;
You can build a data model from scratch and explain the choices behind it;
You have an interest in AI and GenAI and how it applies on top of a data platform;
You have a university degree or equivalent experience;
You are a team player with strong communication skills and are comfortable in front of a client;
Experience with Azure or AWS data services, or a cloud certification;
Familiarity with dbt or similar transformation tooling;
Exposure to data management frameworks such as DAMA-DMBoK, or to data quality practice;
An advanced Snowflake certification (SnowPro Advanced: Architect or Data Engineer).
You are fluent in English and in Dutch or French. Additional languages are a plus.

Our story

Technology does not stand still. It takes innovative approaches to transform, modernize, and run existing technology platforms. The key is knowing when to take advantage of the new technologies to drive product and service enhancements, improve financial performance, and accelerate speed to market.

When you harness the power of analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence (AI), you can uncover hidden relationships from vast amounts of data. Implementing the right strategy and technology will balance speed, cost, and quality to deliver measurable business value.

Who is Deloitte?

We provide industry-leading audit and assurance, tax and legal, consulting and related services. We are committed to driving innovation across offerings to help our clients address their challenges, while giving our professionals opportunities to learn and grow in this era of transformation.

In Belgium, +5000 dedicated professionals active in +10 offices, take great pride in bringing multidisciplinary expertise to a wide variety of clients, from national and international companies, small, fast-growing and large organizations to public institutions and governmental authorities.

Why Deloitte?

Be the true you!
We foster diversity and inclusion and encourage you to bring your authentic self to work. Explore, question and collaborate while building a career that inspires and energises you.

Never stop growing!
Diversity of thought makes us stronger. At Deloitte, we tailor a personalized learning experience, offering you the opportunity to grow at your own pace and achieve maximum impact.

We practice what we preach!
As a Purpose-led organisation, at the heart of everything we do is a set of timeless principles and unifying values .

Life looks different for each of us, so we created a varied benefits package that you can tap into:

My Benefits My Choice, a flexible rewards plan tailored to your lifestyle and priorities
Sustainable transport options offered by Mobility@Deloitte
Flexible work arrangements for all and initiatives supported by Parents & Caregivers @Deloitte
Wellbeing tips and activities powered by Energise@Deloitte
Topped off with other health benefits and insurance opportunities

Empowering our employees with flexible work arrangements
remains essential in today's reality:

Hybrid workplace: combination of home office and on-site (+10 offices in Belgium or client's premises).
Part-time employment: all our jobs are open to full-time or part-time work under a 90% or 80% regime.

jobs.description:
Job Description

About the role

Responsibilities

As a Data Engineer, you play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business and technology, ensuring the seamless integration of our Axon™
software into our clients' tech ecosystems. Your primary responsibilities include:

Contribute to the Data Integration Framework: Develop and enhance a robust framework that feeds into a graph data model for the digital twin of large industrial supply chains.
Work with Complex Supply Chains: Collaborate with clients managing large and intricate supply chains, ensuring the seamless integration of data from various sources into the graph model.
Handle Big Data: Manage, process, and optimize performance for large-scale datasets, ensuring the system can handle the demands of big data environments.
Develop New Features: Lead the development of new features for the data integration framework, contributing to the growth and adaptability of the system.
Manage Data Integration Projects: Oversee the data integration tracks within Axon projects, ensuring objectives are met, and maintain clear documentation to support collaboration and future reference.
Write High-Quality Code: Ensure clean, maintainable, and efficient code that meets the needs of both internal and external users, enhancing the overall user experience and functionality.
Optimize Pipeline Performance: Continuously improve the data pipeline to reduce processing times, improve throughput, and ensure scalability for future growth.
Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams: Work alongside cross-functional teams, including solution experts, software engineers, data scientists, and analytics specialists, throughout the entire development lifecycle, from conception to testing.

Job Requirements

About you 

You hold a Bachelor´s degree in Information Technology or a related field. A Master´s degree is a plus.
You bring 2-3 years of experience in data engineering, ideally within a cloud-based environment and/or on product platforms.
You are proficient in ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes and have a strong understanding of big data principles.
You are skilled in Scala or PySpark, and tools like Azure Synapse and/or Databricks.
You have hands-on experience with modern system design practices and a solid understanding of source control, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
You enjoy exploring new technologies, staying updated with the latest trends, and understanding the functional side of things.
You bring strong communication skills, value collaboration, and align with Bluecrux’s core values of open-mindedness, ambition, humility, and a passion for tackling challenges together.
You feel connected with and are ready to represent our company values: dig deep, own it, come together, move fast and be kind!
You are fluent in English.
Bonus Skills: You have an interest in or are familiar with the supply chain sector or supply chain data models .

Why join us?

High‑impact work on complex, real‑life problems within a growing SaaS product.
Meaningful variety in daily work—no routine days, plenty of challenge and growth.
Ownership & autonomy —bring your ideas, shape the product, and drive initiatives.
Continuous learning with exposure to multiple technologies, roles, and skill‑building opportunities.
Dynamic scale‑up environment that’s ambitious, collaborative, and full of energy.
Supply chains are more complex than ever, with scattered systems, partners, and disruptions creating blind spots. Axon brings everything into one unified view so teams can finally see clearly and make better decisions.
AI and simulation are now essential as static rules and traditional tools can’t keep up with today’s volatility. Axon uses AI/ML to unify data and run advanced simulations, helping organizations make confident, resilient decisions.
Flexibility in working hours, and a 50/50 hybrid model in our Mechelen office.
Supportive culture where every voice matters and teams truly have each other’s backs, with great onboarding, mentorship, and cross‑team collaboration.
Engaging Team Events: From monthly gatherings to Bluecrux weekends, we know how to have fun together!
Competitive Benefits: Enjoy benefits such as a competitive salary including a bonus and an electric company car with convenient charging options.

About us

Start your career shaping the future of supply chains.

Bluecrux is a value chain consulting and technology company, specializing in transformative solutions for today’s complex supply chain landscape. We collaborate closely with industry leaders like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bridgestone, AkzoNobel, Beiersdorf, Oatly, and many more – creating partnerships that drive meaningful impact. With a global presence in Europe, the US and APAC, we’re committed to shaping the future of value chains, one success story at a time.

Axon
helps companies bring scattered supply chain data together in one clear view, so our clients can better understand what is happening, make smarter decisions, and act faster. Our platform is currently used in Life Sciences and Healthcare, where supply chains are highly complex and decisions can directly impact the launch, availability, and access to products.

Axon is also still in a scale-up phase. There is a strong product vision, many new ideas to build, and a lot of product innovation still ahead.

Et si vous mettiez la donnée au cœur de la transformation énergétique ?

Producteur indépendant d’électricité photovoltaïque, Urbasolar développe, construit et exploite des centrales solaires en France et à l’international. Filiale du groupe Axpo, nous conjuguons l’agilité d’une entreprise innovante avec la solidité et l’expertise d’un grand groupe énergétique européen.

Pour accompagner notre transformation et faire de la donnée un véritable actif d’entreprise, nous recherchons un·e Data Engineer F/H/NB.

Vous rejoindrez une équipe engagée dans la construction d’une plateforme Data moderne, au cœur du système d’information d’Urbasolar. Cette plateforme constitue à la fois le pivot des échanges entre nos applications, le socle du pilotage de l’entreprise et l’une des fondations de nos futurs usages d’intelligence artificielle.

Notre ambition est claire : disposer de données fiables, gouvernées et facilement accessibles afin de mieux piloter nos projets, améliorer notre performance et rendre possibles de nouveaux services digitaux et des agents IA au service des métiers. Cette trajectoire vise à unifier les données transverses dans un Data Warehouse d’entreprise et à maîtriser leur mise à disposition dans les outils de reporting et les applications.

Votre rôle

En tant que Data Engineer F/H/NB, vous participez à la conception, à la construction, à l’industrialisation et à l’exploitation des solutions permettant de collecter, structurer, transformer, fiabiliser et mettre à disposition les données de l’entreprise.

Vous intervenez sur des cas d’usage concrets et stratégiques : pilotage des projets photovoltaïques, consolidation des données financières et opérationnelles, échanges inter-applications, reporting d’entreprise, digitalisation des processus et préparation des données nécessaires aux futurs usages d’intelligence artificielle.

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec le Data Manager, les équipes IT et digitales, les Product Owners et les experts métiers. Vous contribuez à construire une vision cohérente des données de l’entreprise, à identifier les sources de vérité et à limiter la duplication des informations.

Vos principales missions

Participer aux ateliers de cadrage et de conception des solutions Data.
Analyser les besoins métiers et techniques, puis les traduire en modèles de données, flux, règles de transformation et contrôles de qualité.
Développer et industrialiser les traitements d’ingestion, de transformation, d’enrichissement, de stockage et d’exposition des données.
Concevoir des pipelines robustes, automatisés, supervisés et maintenables.
Contribuer à la modélisation du Data Warehouse d’entreprise et à la convergence progressive vers des modèles de données communs et réutilisables.
Développer et maintenir les interfaces entre la plateforme Data et les applications métiers.
Mettre en place les contrôles, alertes, logs et mécanismes de supervision nécessaires à la fiabilité des flux.
Préparer et réaliser les tests unitaires, fonctionnels, de performance et de bout en bout.
Assurer la maintenance corrective et évolutive des solutions, analyser les incidents et participer au support de niveaux 2 et 3.
Documenter les modèles, les flux, les règles de gestion, les dépendances et les procédures d’exploitation.
Contribuer à la qualité, à la traçabilité et à la gouvernance des données.
Participer aux choix technologiques et à l’amélioration continue de notre plateforme.
Explorer les possibilités offertes par l’automatisation, l’IA générative et les agents intelligents pour faciliter l’accès aux informations et créer de nouveaux usages métiers.

Un environnement technologique moderne

Vous évoluerez au sein d’un système d’information résolument tourné vers le Cloud, l’interopérabilité et les services managés.

Notre environnement Data s’appuie notamment sur :

Microsoft Fabric pour l’ingestion, l’orchestration, le stockage et la transformation des données ;
Microsoft Azure et ses services Cloud ;
Python pour le traitement, l’automatisation et l’industrialisation des données ;
Les API et les mécanismes d’intégration inter-applications ;
Microsoft 365, SharePoint et l’écosystème Power Platform ;
Airtable, utilisé en complément pour certains usages collaboratifs et métiers ;
Jira et Confluence pour le suivi des réalisations et la documentation.

Notre objectif n’est pas seulement d’exploiter une stack moderne. Nous voulons construire une infrastructure AI-ready, capable de fournir aux modèles, assistants et agents IA des données fiables, contextualisées, sécurisées et traçables. Notre feuille de route prévoit notamment de faire le lien entre documentation et données grâce à l’IA et de repenser les interfaces d’échange avec les utilisateurs.

Vous êtes issu·e d’une formation supérieure en informatique, Data, ingénierie ou dans un domaine équivalent, et vous disposez idéalement de 2 à 10 ans d’expérience dans l’exploitation, l’intégration ou le traitement des données.

Key Responsibilities

Own complex batch or streaming pipelines from design through production support, coordinating dependencies and resolving data-quality and performance issues independently.
Contribute to data architecture, reusable frameworks, code reviews, observability improvements and the coaching of less-experienced engineers.

Design, implement, and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines using Python and modern data engineering frameworks.
Build reliable ingestion and transformation processes from internal and external data sources, including APIs, databases, files, and events.
Develop reusable data processing components and frameworks following software engineering best practices.

Write clean, testable code with unit and integration tests for data pipelines and processing components.
Instrument pipelines with logging, metrics, alerts, and operational monitoring.

Performance, Scalability & Architecture

Optimize data processing performance, storage layouts, query efficiency, and platform resource usage.
Design pipelines for scalability and resilience using retries, idempotency, checkpointing, and backpressure patterns.
Apply partitioning, caching, and parallelization strategies where appropriate.

Security, Governance & Continuous Improvement

Implement secure data handling practices, including access controls, encryption, secrets management, and compliant data processing.
Ensure alignment with enterprise, regulatory, privacy, data classification, retention, and lineage requirements.
Support audits and data governance processes where required.

Demonstrates independent ownership of complex data solutions, strong technical judgement and measurable improvement in trust, performance and reliability.
Reliable delivery and operation of scalable data pipelines and data platform components.
Trusted data assets with strong accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and observability controls.
Clean, testable, documented, and maintainable Python and SQL-based data engineering solutions.
Effective support for incidents, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and durable remediation.
Provide mentorship and guidance to less experienced team members.

Fluency in English. Any additional language(s) are highly appreciated.
Professional experience building data pipelines and data platforms using Python.
Strong experience with SQL and data modeling concepts, including dimensional, normalized, analytical, or lakehouse patterns.
Hands-on experience with relational and analytical data stores, such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, data warehouses, or data lakes.
Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, and code reviews for data workloads.
Advance knowledge of cloud platforms, with Azure/Fabric, and relevant data services.
Work effectively as part of a team, contributing to collective success while remaining open to feedback and coaching from more experienced colleagues.
Strong understanding of data security, access control, observability, and production support practices.
4+ Years of Experience are required.

Preferred Experience

Experience with modern data frameworks and tools such as Spark, Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or equivalent platforms.

Advanced Experience With Lakehouse Or Warehouse Platforms

Avec plus de 20 ans d’existence, notre groupe compte aujourd’hui plus de 1 500 missions chez nos clients (ETI, SBF 120, CAC 40, secteur public, associatif et ONG). Il réunit une communauté de plus de 650 collaborateurs, pour un chiffre d’affaires de plus de 86 millions d’euros.

Historiquement présent sur le marché français, en Île-de-France, à Lille, Lyon, Nantes et Toulouse, il se développe désormais aussi à l’international.

ACT-ON DATA
est l’entité Data d’ ACT-ON GROUP
. Nos 80 consultants interviennent auprès de grands comptes publics et privés — COVEA, RTE, les Ministères sociaux, l’INSERM, la RATP, Société Générale, TotalEnergies, IFREMER
— sur toute la chaîne de valeur : architecture et plateformes Data, Data Engineering, DataViz, Data Science et IA générative
.

Notre particularité : une expertise Data de bout en bout
, une spécialisation en Data RH
et notre propre produit Data for People
. Vous rejoignez ainsi un collectif où les compétences sont partagées et où vous n’êtes jamais seul face à une problématique technique.

Description Du Poste

Sans pipeline fiable, pas de dashboard crédible ni de modèle exploitable.

Chez Act-On Data, le Data Engineer n’est pas en bout de chaîne : il travaille aux côtés des Data Analysts, des Data Scientists et des équipes SI du client, et ses choix engagent toute la suite.

Vos missions

Intégré·e à Une Équipe Projet, Vous Construisez Et Industrialisez Les Chaînes De Données De Nos Grands Clients

Vous collectez et intégrez les données issues de sources multiples, en environnement On Premise ou Cloud.
Vous développez et optimisez les traitements de préparation : nettoyage, transformation, agrégation.
Vous modélisez les datasets en veillant à leur cohérence et à leur exploitabilité réelle par les équipes analytiques et métier.
Vous mettez en œuvre les contrôles de qualité et traitez les anomalies détectées — avant que le métier ne les découvre.
Vous industrialisez et automatisez les flux jusqu’à la mise en production.
Vous maintenez et faites évoluer les chaînes d’intégration déjà en place, et vous rédigez la documentation technique associée.
Vous travaillez en méthode Agile, en interaction directe avec les Data Analysts, les Data Scientists et les équipes SI du client.

Qualifications

Au moins 3 ans d’expérience, dont au moins 1 an sur des fonctions de Data Engineering.
La maîtrise de Python et de SQL, et une réelle aisance sur les problématiques de performance à gros volumes.
Une expérience concrète d’au moins un environnement Cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP).
La pratique d’au moins un outil de préparation ou d’intégration de données du marché (Databricks, Alteryx, Talend, SSIS ou équivalent).
La connaissance de la chaîne d’intégration technique de bout en bout et des enjeux de qualité des données.
La capacité à modéliser un dataset au service d’un usage analytique.

Ce qui serait un plus

Une certification sur un environnement Cloud ou sur une plateforme data.
Une pratique des approches CI/CD appliquées aux traitements de données.
Une appétence pour les problématiques RH — c’est le cœur de nos missions, et cela s’apprend chez nous.
Un bon niveau d’anglais.

Et surtout

Autonome, curieux·se et doté·e d’un bon sens relationnel, vous appréciez le travail en équipe et vous avez un vrai appétit pour continuer d’apprendre. Si vous ne cochez pas 100 % des cases ci-dessus mais que le poste vous parle : candidatez, nous en discuterons.

Informations supplémentaires

POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ?

Votre parcours chez nous

Ce poste n’est pas une fin en soi. À deux ou trois ans, et selon vos appétences, il ouvre sur plusieurs trajectoires : le lead technique sur une plateforme data, l’architecture Cloud, les pratiques d’industrialisation (CI/CD, MLOps), ou le rapprochement avec la Data Science. Le processus de recrutement

Au sein de l'équipe DEP, le poste consiste à participer au déploiement de la Data Platform CDF (Cognite) prévu sur 36 assets de la compagnie. De valider l'éligibilité technique et données des sites concernés (mettre en place des solutions permettant d'accélérer la phase d'analyse : isponibilité des données, qualité des données, complétude.. )
De développer des outils d'analyse des données (ex : DataBricks, Power BI, Cognite) et réaliserez des analyses adhoc sur ces jeux de données pour préparer les déploiements (Data Discovery, DataPrep). Un accent particulier sera mis sur la documentation et le scaling.

Vous vous reconnaissez ? N'attendez plus... postulez pour rejoindre les équipes TotalEnergies du CSTJF à Pau !

Profil du candidat

Vous avez récemment été diplômé(e) d’un Bac+5 dans le domaine de l'information ou bien de la Data ? Débutez votre carrière par une expérience stimulante au cœur d’équipes internationales, engagées dans la transition énergétique !

Nous recherchons pour une durée de 12 mois, un.e Data Engineer for Cognite Platform (CDF) - débutant H/F à partir de décembre 2026.

Vous possédez une expérience en data engineering et maîtrisez la mise en œuvre de data pipelines, l'exploration de données et le développement d'API. Votre capacité à structurer, exploiter et valoriser les données au service des utilisateurs fera la différence.

Posséder une bonne capacité rédactionnelle ainsi qu'une maitrise professionnelle de l’anglais seront indispensables à votre prise de poste.

Nous vous proposons un Contrat de Professionnalisation Temps Plein qualifiant de 12 mois (100% en entreprise) incluant un volet de formations (métier, linguistique, outils…). Ces formations sont dispensées en interne par des organismes sélectionnés par TotalEnergies.

Ce contrat vous permettra d’acquérir une année d’expérience professionnelle tout en étant formé aux spécificités de votre métier en lien avec les activités de la Compagnie. Un réel atout pour booster votre employabilité !

Informations supplémentaires

Pour postuler à cette offre, vous devez impérativement posséder, à la date d’embauche, un titre de séjour valide pour la période couverte par cette offre (minimum 13 mois).

Attention, la conclusion de ce contrat de professionnalisation ne permet pas la délivrance d’un titre de séjour (article R.52221-6 du Code du travail).

Ce poste ne s'adresse pas aux personnes recherchant une alternance avec une école ou une formation diplômante, mais aux personnes récemment diplômées à la recherche d'une première expérience.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Can’t wait to make an impact on the world?

You’re not alone. We strongly believe that data and the intelligent use of it hold a lot of potential for making an impact that matters to our clients, our people and society.

Join us in making this impact!

Your journey with us

The life of a Senior Data Engineer is very diverse. From implementing, code reviewing, and debugging data pipelines to leading large teams in complex data migrations for our clients.

Your role and tasks can switch frequently depending on the project at hand, meaning that one day you might be building a data warehouse and the next you are assisting our cloud team with providing the right information for the ideal setup for a large data platform.

You will be the key link between Deloitte leadership, Client leadership, your own technical team and both the technical & business teams at the client.

Internally you will leverage your knowledge & experience to bring your fellow data engineers to the next level, while also build PoC’s accelerators that will help our clients in getting the most out of their data.

Key Responsibilities

As a lead specialist you will actively share your data engineering expertise with the junior members of the team (Business analysts, consultants) in a coaching role.
Working within client project teams in a hands-on way to deliver data engineering solutions that address their complex needs.
You provide various types of data engineering services to clients, continuously evolving by learning new tools, methodologies, and diversifying your expertise.
You keep a strong focus on best practices to enhance the impact of our solutions on client outcomes.
You deliver exceptional client service, focusing on problem-solving, developing others, and building strong relationships.
From a technology stack perspective, your main focus will be on Azure . But experience in other technologies such as AWS, Snowflake and Google are equally appreciated.
You proactively broaden and deepen relationships with senior-level clients, identifying additional opportunities for collaboration.

Let's Talk About You

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in data engineering, with a proven track record of delivering large-scale data solutions.
Proficiency in cloud platforms, preferably on the Azure technology stack.
Proven experience with data modelling techniques such Kimball & Data vault.
Expertise skill in SQL (any variant) is a must.
Strong familiarity with other standard practices languages (such as Python, Java, or Scala)
Knowledge of data governance frameworks and best practices.
Strong leadership, problem-solving, and client relationship management skills, you are energized by sharing your knowledge with other (junior) team members.
You are fluent in English and French and/or Dutch

Our story

Technology does not stand still. It takes innovative approaches to transform, modernize, and run existing technology platforms. The key is knowing when to take advantage of the new technologies to drive product and service enhancements, improve financial performance, and accelerate speed to market.

When you harness the power of analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence (AI), you can uncover hidden relationships from vast amounts of data. Implementing the right strategy and technology will balance speed, cost, and quality to deliver measurable business value.

Who is Deloitte?

We provide industry-leading audit and assurance, tax and legal, consulting and related services. We are committed to driving innovation across offerings to help our clients address their challenges, while giving our professionals opportunities to learn and grow in this era of transformation.

In Belgium, +5000 dedicated professionals active in +10 offices, take great pride in bringing multidisciplinary expertise to a wide variety of clients, from national and international companies, small, fast-growing and large organizations to public institutions and governmental authorities.

Why Deloitte?

Be the true you!
We foster diversity and inclusion and encourage you to bring your authentic self to work. Explore, question and collaborate while building a career that inspires and energises you.

Never stop growing!
Diversity of thought makes us stronger. At Deloitte, we tailor a personalized learning experience, offering you the opportunity to grow at your own pace and achieve maximum impact.

We practice what we preach!
As a Purpose-led organisation, at the heart of everything we do is a set of timeless principles and unifying values .

Life looks different for each of us, so we created a varied benefits package that you can tap into:

My Benefits My Choice, a flexible rewards plan tailored to your lifestyle and priorities
Sustainable transport options offered by Mobility@Deloitte
Flexible work arrangements for all and initiatives supported by Parents & Caregivers @Deloitte
Wellbeing tips and activities powered by Energise@Deloitte
Topped off with other health benefits and insurance opportunities

Empowering our employees with flexible work arrangements
remains essential in today's reality:

Hybrid workplace: combination of home office and on-site (+10 offices in Belgium or client's premises).
Part-time employment: all our jobs are open to full-time or part-time work under a 90% or 80% regime.

Join us to make an impact together! Apply now!

À la MC, chaque jour compte. Pour les gens, pour la société et pour soi-même.

Avec 650 collègues ICT, nous travaillons ensemble chaque jour pour fournir le meilleur service à nos 4,7 millions de membres et à nos près de 8.000 membres du personnel.

Flexibilité garantie ! Possibilité de travailler à domicile 4 jours par semaine ou depuis l’un de nos bureaux régionaux.

Description de fonction

L'équipe Data Analytics soutient la MC dans son ambition de devenir la mutualité la plus orientée données de Belgique. Nous accompagnons l'organisation tout au long de son parcours data et analytique et développons des solutions sur mesure basées sur des technologies modernes. Nous aidons ainsi les différents domaines métier à exploiter pleinement leurs données afin de stimuler l'innovation, optimiser les processus et atteindre leurs objectifs stratégiques.

Notre expertise couvre notamment la stratégie de données, la gouvernance des données, l'analytique avancée, l'animation d'ateliers d'innovation ainsi que le développement de solutions data sur mesure.

Vous rejoignez une équipe multiculturelle composée d'environ 30 professionnels, parmi lesquels des Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Reporting Specialists et Analystes. Ensemble, nous concevons des solutions innovantes au service des différents domaines métier de la MC.

Aujourd'hui, l'équipe est au cœur d'une transformation majeure. Nous évoluons d'un modèle de services centralisé vers des équipes Agile orientées domaine, où les métiers et l'IT partagent la responsabilité des solutions de données qu'ils développent et gèrent.

En tant que Data Engineer, vous êtes responsable de la collecte, du traitement et de la mise à disposition des données de manière fiable et efficace pour les besoins d’analyse et de reporting. Vous veillez par ailleurs à la qualité et à la continuité de l’environnement de données et soutenez l’organisation dans la réalisation de ses ambitions en matière de gestion et de valorisation des données.

Vos responsabilités

Intégration et développement de pipelines de données

Concevoir, développer et maintenir des pipelines de données évolutifs.
Intégrer et ingérer des données provenant de systèmes opérationnels et de sources externes vers les différentes plateformes de données de la MC.
Construire et automatiser les processus ETL/ELT.
Surveiller, optimiser et résoudre les problèmes liés aux flux de traitement des données.
Documenter les modèles de données et les pipelines.

Qualité et fiabilité des données

Garantir des standards élevés en matière de qualité, de cohérence, de disponibilité et de performance des données.
Mettre en place des mécanismes de monitoring, de validation et de contrôle qualité.
Analyser et résoudre les incidents et problèmes liés aux données.
Veiller au respect des normes de sécurité, de confidentialité, de gouvernance et d’architecture.
Contribuer à l’amélioration continue de la plateforme de données et des processus associés.

Collaboration et delivery

Collaborer avec les Product Owners, experts métier, Data Analysts et Data Scientists au sein d’équipes multidisciplinaires.
Soutenir les initiatives de reporting, d’analytics, de self-service BI et d’intelligence artificielle.
Participer activement aux cérémonies Agile et contribuer à l’amélioration continue.
Partager activement les connaissances et promouvoir les bonnes pratiques au sein de la communauté Data & Analytics.

Le profil idéal

Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme de bachelier ou master en informatique, technologies de l’information ou dans un domaine connexe.
Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée en Data Engineering, notamment dans la conception de pipelines de données, les processus ETL/ELT et les activités de transformation de données.
Vous avez de l’expérience avec les Data Warehouses (DWH) et les composantes d’architecture de données, aussi bien on-premise que dans le cloud. Une expérience des services cloud AWS est un réel atout
Vous êtes capable de modéliser des solutions de données (Kimball, DataVault, …).
Vous possédez une bonne connaissance des bases de données et de SQL, ainsi qu’une expérience démontrée avec des langages de scripting tels que Python ou Bash, et des outils modernes de Data Engineering comme DBT ou Airflow.
Vous avez une bonne compréhension des principes et pratiques DevOps, appliqués aux flux et solutions orientés données.
Vous êtes familiarisé avec les pipelines CI/CD (Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment).
Vous disposez d’un fort esprit analytique et de solides capacités de résolution de problèmes, combinés à d’excellentes compétences en communication.
Vous êtes orienté client et résultats, appréciez le travail en équipe et adoptez une démarche d’apprentissage continu

Notre proposition

Une rémunération attractive : Vous bénéficiez d'un contrat à durée indéterminée, , d’un salaire attrayant et d'un ensemble d'avantages intéressants : chèques-repas de 9 euros et restaurant d’entreprise, 13e mois, prime supplémentaire en juillet, une indemnité forfaitaire nette, 100% des transports en commun remboursés, indemnité vélo, allocations familiales supplémentaires, assurance groupe, assurance hospitalisation, assurance revenu garanti, location de vélos, ...

Travail flexible : Vous travaillerez avec des horaires de travail flexibles avec possibilité de travailler à domicile jusqu’4 jours par semaine ou depuis l'un de nos bureaux régionaux.

Impact social: à La MC, vous ne faites pas que travailler. Avec vos collègues, vous contribuez directement ou indirectement à la santé de nombreuses personnes. Votre travail a une véritable signification.

Formation et possibilités de croissance: à La MC, vous êtes aux commandes de votre carrière. Vous avez la possibilité d'évoluer dans votre travail et dans l'organisation.

Team : Des collègues formidables et une culture d'entreprise dynamique et ouverte, visant à obtenir des résultats exceptionnels ensemble.

jobs.title: Data Engineer - AI & Data Platforms
jobs.description:
Why Keyrus, Why Now!

Keyrus
is an international group of 3000 experts
across 30 countries
, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.
For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work - designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalize intelligence.

Intelligent systems are only as dependable as the data beneath them. Reliable pipelines, trusted data products, governed access, and meaningful enterprise context allow analytics, applications, models, and agents to operate consistently in production.

Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates
.
Industrial discipline connects the two.

What You'll Architect

As a Data Engineer - AI & Data Platforms, you will design, build, and operate reliable data products and pipelines that support analytics, applications, and intelligent systems.

This is fundamentally a Data Engineering role, with an additional focus on preparing enterprise data for modern AI use cases. You will work across structured and unstructured information, transforming source data into trusted, reusable data products that can support analytics and operational applications as well as RAG, retrieval, evaluation, and agent-enabled systems.

Your Responsibilities

Design, build, test, and operate production data pipelines and data products, moving data reliably from enterprise source systems into reusable consumption layers.
Develop and maintain data models and transformation logic that preserve clear definitions, business context, and reliable use across analytical, operational, and AI workloads.
Implement data quality, lineage, metadata, and observability controls, ensuring critical data is trustworthy, understandable, and monitored in production.
Prepare structured and unstructured enterprise data for intelligent systems, including retrieval, grounding, RAG, semantic context, and evaluation datasets where required.
Engineer reliable ingestion and processing patterns across APIs, databases, files, documents, events, and other relevant enterprise sources.
Operate and improve data workloads in a major cloud/data ecosystem, balancing reliability, scalability, security, performance, and cost.
Collaborate with AI Engineers and Software Engineers on stable data interfaces, without taking ownership of model behavior, agents, or the surrounding application.
Document and reuse data-engineering patterns, including data contracts, transformations, controls, dependencies, and operational knowledge that can strengthen future Keyrus engagements.

Who You Are

You are a hands-on Data Engineer who understands that moving data is not enough. Data must remain trusted, understandable, available, and usable once a system is operating in production.

You think from source to consumption and can determine what is required to turn fragmented enterprise data into reliable data products.

You combine strong engineering fundamentals with practical judgment. You understand that analytics, applications, RAG systems, evaluations, and agents may consume data differently, and you design the foundation accordingly without trying to own the intelligence or application layers yourself.

What You Bring

Must Have

Strong hands-on experience designing, building, and operating production data pipelines and data products.
Strong SQL and data-modeling fundamentals, with the ability to design clear, maintainable transformation and consumption layers.
Practical engineering capability in Python or another language commonly used for production data engineering.
Deep practical expertise in at least one major cloud data ecosystem, with the ability to apply the same engineering principles across comparable technologies.
Experience implementing data quality, testing, monitoring, lineage, or observability within production data workflows.
Understanding of production engineering concerns including reliability, scalability, security, access, maintainability, and performance.

Should Have

Experience preparing structured and unstructured data for AI or GenAI use cases.
Practical understanding of how RAG, retrieval, embeddings, semantic context, and evaluation datasets depend on enterprise data.
Experience working with distributed processing, orchestration, and modern data-transformation approaches.
Experience with batch ingestion and one or more additional patterns such as APIs, change data capture, event-driven processing, or streaming.
Working knowledge of CI/CD, automated testing, version control, and repeatable deployment practices for data solutions.
Experience with vector or hybrid search infrastructure used for retrieval-based AI systems/ Feeding and maintaining RAG indexes
Rapid prototyping, from mockup to working proof of concept in days (Streamlit)
Experience collaborating with AI, software, analytics, architecture, or governance teams that consume or define requirements for the data products you build.

Could Have

Experience with semantic layers, knowledge graphs, ontologies, or enterprise knowledge architectures.
Experience building data foundations for agentic systems or complex GenAI applications.
Experience with real-time or high-volume streaming architectures.
Experience with ML data pipelines, feature stores, evaluation datasets, or MLOps integration
Dashboards when needed, BI restitution on top of the data products
Experience in regulated, high-security, or data-sovereignty-sensitive environments.
Consulting or professional-services experience.

Illustrative Technology Environments - Not All Required

Depending on the engagement, Keyrus data environments may include technologies such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, BigQuery, Redshift, Spark, dbt, Airflow, or comparable cloud-native data services and orchestration technologies.

The role does not require expertise across all of these platforms. Candidates should demonstrate strong depth in at least one relevant ecosystem and the engineering judgment to work across comparable environments.

What Makes You Successful

You think in terms of trusted data products, not pipelines as an end in themselves.
You combine strong engineering fundamentals with production discipline.
You identify data-quality and reliability risks before they become downstream AI or application failures.
You know when a requirement belongs to Data Engineering and when it should move to AI, Software, Architecture, or Governance.
You make pragmatic decisions about performance, scalability, maintainability, and cost.
You document what you build and turn successful data patterns into reusable knowledge across engagements.

Rewards - What We Offer At Keyrus

Growth

At Keyrus we have created an environment where people are supported, challenged and connected to the people around them.

Working on impactful Data & Digital projects you will develop a broad and versatile skill set and stay ahead in a fast-evolving, AI-driven landscape.

Our digital learning platform, with over 30,000 courses including in-house trainings developed by our experts, is a perfect way to stay on top of your game

A generous training budget is available to help foster a culture where learning, feedback and continuous improvement is the norm

You will have a dedicated coach, benefit from regular check-ins, learn via different communities and have clear alignment with your team and company goals

We want you to grow with confidence. We therefore place a strong emphasis on ownership, open feedback and continuous development.

When people feel trusted, connected and inspired, they do their best work!

Rewards

Mobility budget? Car with fuel or charging car? We offer both so you can choose!

On top of that we also have daily and monthly net allowances, eco vouchers, hospitalisation (DKV) insurance and group insurance, as well as a generous bonus scheme that you can use on our flexible reward plan.

What We Stand For

Collective Intelligence
— We combine expertise, functions, and geographies to solve complex client challenges.

Reliability
— We deliver complex work with rigor and build lasting client trust.

Pragmatism
— We prioritize concrete impact and measurable value over abstract technological discourse.

Entrepreneurial Spirit
— Curiosity, energy, and freedom enable initiative and sustained innovation.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process straightforward and respect candidates' time. The local process should normally include:

A conversation with the Talent team to discuss the candidate's background, expectations, and what Keyrus can offer.
A technical architecture conversation focused on recent production AI architecture, architecture decisions, system boundaries, non-functional requirements, and the candidate's primary technology ecosystem.
An architecture case or representative challenge to understand how the candidate evaluates trade-offs, defines a target architecture, and communicates decisions to engineering and client stakeholders, followed by a final conversation with the relevant technical or business leadership. The assessment should focus on architectural proficiency and decision-making rather than the number of technologies a candidate can list.

About Keyrus

At Keyrus, we help organizations move from experimental to industrialized AI, from isolated agents to orchestrated systems, and from insight to execution. As Architects of Intelligence
, we design the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, embedding intelligence into business processes so that it creates sustainable, measurable value. We operationalize intelligence
.

Powered by our proprietary Human Orchestrated Model™ (HOM), we architect reliable:

Intelligence Foundations
Human in Command governance
Performance Steering

With 30+ years of expertise and 3000 experts across 30 countries, we build adaptive, resilient intelligent environments where technology amplifies human capability and performance compounds over time.

AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.

Keyrus is listed on Euronext Growth Paris. (ALKEY - ISIN Code: FR0004029411 - Reuters: KEYR.PA - Bloomberg: ALKEY: FP).

For more information: www.keyrus.com

For over 30 years, Keyrus have been Architects of intelligent systems. We have combined engineering, business consulting, data architecture, and AI in real operational environments. We have done this whilst never forgetting a more human enterprise of allowing humans to design, supervise, and shape what only they can create.. Find out more on our services on keyrus.com.

Un profond respect de l’ensemble de nos parties prenantes : consultant(e)s, clients et fournisseurs. Car si le travail “ne fait pas le bonheur”, il peut cependant “faire le malheur”. Nous nous engageons donc à écouter et agir avec honnêteté.

Ceci induit pour les Davidsonien(ne)s d’allier prises d’initiative, engagement et professionnalisme. Car “sans travail, le talent n’est qu’une sale manie”. Et cela nous incite à chercher à recruter des personnes… meilleures que nous…

Nous encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap, et nous nous engageons à répondre au mieux à leurs besoins spécifiques.

Profil / Mission

Au sein d’une industrie qu’elle soit Retail, Luxe, pure player, tourisme ou autre, la Data est au cœur de l’activité.

En effet, il s’agit de maîtriser une architecture Data Centrics, plateforme de référence Data qui fournit des données en temps réel (via API) pour simplifier et accélérer les prises de décisions tech, business et digitales.

Davidson dispose d’un savoir-faire reconnu qui lui permet d’intervenir sur différentes phases d’un projet que ce soit en Conseil et organisation, Cadrage, Définition, Conception ou Optimisation. Nos consultants interviennent sur des projets Data ingénieur, Data Analytics et Data IA.

Ton rôle en tant que Data Engineer sera de contribuer à des projets Data :

Concevoir, développer et maintenir des pipelines de données ETL/ELT sur Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
Conception de data warehouses et data lakes scalables sur BigQuery, optimisation des schémas et partitions
Optimisation des requêtes SQL, gestion du partitionnement, réduction des coûts BigQuery/Dataflow
Versionning (Git), déploiement continu via Terraform, Cloud Build, GitLab CI
Nettoyage, normalisation, contrôle de cohérence ; mise en place de tests et monitoring des données
Stack technique :
Cloud : GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Composer, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Kafka)
Langages : SQL, Python, Java/Scala
Orchestration : Cloud Composer (Airflow), dbt

Pour un client dans le secteur du luxe : concevoir et automatiser des pipelines de données scalables sur Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer) pour alimenter la personnalisation, les recommandations produits et les tableaux de bord business
Pour un autre client : concevoir et automatiser des pipelines de données scalables sur Google Cloud Platform à destination du département marketing digital ( ciblage et activation marketing au travers de campagnes de dernière génération, publicité digitale ciblée, etc.)

Tu aimes travailler en équipe ?
Tu aimes la technique ?

Python, C/C++ ou Java

la mise en place et l'exploitation de services Cloud : AWS / GCP / Azure
