Context & Impact

As Lansweeper scales its SaaS business across new products and markets, trusted data has become critical to how we make executive and board-level decisions. Two questions sit at the center: how is our revenue performing and how are customers using our products? We’re hiring two
Data Engineers to bring structure, trust, and clarity to both.

You’ll join the Data & Analytics team
and work in one of two focus areas:

Revenue Analytics
: Build the foundation for how Lansweeper measures growth: ARR, retention, expansion, and forecasting. Your work will shape how C-level leaders, the board, sales, and finance understand performance and planning.

Product Insights
: Build the pipelines and models that show how customers adopt and use our products. Your work will help product teams decide what to build next and help customer success spot risk and opportunity early.

Both roles share one goal: connecting commercial performance with product behavior, so the business can see not just what is happening, but why. In the near term, you’ll help establish a single source of truth for your domain’s KPIs, build reliable, board- and leadership-ready reporting, and enable the forecasting and insight models that drive go-to-market and product decisions.

You don’t need to know our products or industry already. Curiosity, strong engineering fundamentals, and an interest in the business side of data matter more.

6-12 Month Goals

Develop a strong understanding of the data platform, architecture, and key data flows supporting business reporting and analytics.
Become a trusted partner for internal stakeholders by delivering reliable, well-structured, and scalable data solutions that support decision-making.
Improve the quality, consistency, and availability of data by strengthening pipelines, models, and data management practices.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions.
Support the company’s data maturity by enabling better access to trusted data and contributing to a scalable analytics foundation.

Challenges

The Main Challenges You'll Face Are:

Working within a growing organization where data sources, systems, and business processes have evolved over time and may have been customized to meet specific needs.
Designing scalable and maintainable data solutions in an environment where requirements may change frequently as the business grows.
Ensuring data quality, consistency, and reliability across multiple systems and pipelines, while managing dependencies and complexity.
Translating business needs into technical implementations that are both practical and aligned with long-term platform standards.

Key Responsibilities

For both roles:

Build, maintain, and improve data pipelines and models that power executive-level reporting and board-ready metrics in your focus area
Establish a single, trusted source of truth for your domain’s KPIs, reconciling data across systems of record
Build the curated data models and semantic layer that power dashboards and reporting, in partnership with analysts
Partner with business stakeholders (sales operations, finance, product, customer success) to understand evolving processes and reflect them accurately in our data models
Investigate data anomalies and trace them back to their source (pipeline issue, upstream system change, or genuine business shift), then work with stakeholders to resolve them
Proactively improve data quality and integrity across your pipelines to ensure consistent, reliable reporting
Month-end close support: Reporting is time-critical at month-end. When the end of the month falls on a weekend, you’ll be part of a rotation to monitor the pipelines and make sure the numbers are ready for finance and leadership on the next business day. This is occasional and planned in advance, and the load is shared across the team.

Revenue Analytics Track:

Own revenue data models covering ARR, MRR, churn, expansion, contraction, and renewal cycles
Reconcile revenue data across CRM, billing, and ERP to produce one consistent view of financial KPIs
Build and maintain the data foundation for forecasting models, working with analysts to support go-to-market planning
Work closely with sales and finance operations to keep revenue models aligned with how the business actually sells and bills

Product Insights Track:

Own product usage and adoption data models covering active usage, feature adoption, engagement, and customer health
Integrate product telemetry with commercial data (accounts, subscriptions, renewals) so usage can be tied to retention and expansion
Define and maintain product KPIs together with product management and customer success
Build the foundations of the self-serve dashboards and insight models that help product teams prioritize and help customer success spot risk and opportunity early

Key Requirements

For both roles:

Hard skills:
Strong SQL: you can write, optimize, and debug complex queries against large datasets
Data modelling: familiarity with best practices such as dimensional modelling and slowly changing dimensions
Pipeline engineering: experience building and maintaining reliable, tested data pipelines, including monitoring and data quality checks
Supporting reporting: experience preparing data models that feed business-facing dashboards and reports
Strong plus: experience with Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran

Soft skills:
Business understanding: you take the time to understand how the business works and why the numbers matter, and you can explain technical decisions and data issues in plain language to non-technical colleagues
Stakeholder collaboration: you work well with analysts, finance, sales ops, product, and customer success, adapting your communication to each
Ownership mindset: you take initiative, work independently, and drive outcomes without waiting to be directed
Reliability: you’re comfortable owning time-critical deliverables, including occasional month-end weekend monitoring as part of a team rotation

Revenue Analytics Track:

SaaS financial metrics: solid understanding of how revenue, bookings, churn, ARR, MRR, expansion, contraction, and renewal KPIs are defined and measured
Systems reconciliation: hands-on experience resolving data mismatches between CRM, billing, and ERP to produce a reliable single source of truth
Nice to have: experience with Salesforce and NetSuite data, or with forecasting models

Product Insights Track:

Product and usage data: experience modelling event, telemetry, or usage data, such as active usage, feature adoption, and engagement
Linking usage to business outcomes: understanding of how product behavior connects to retention, expansion, and customer health
Nice to have: experience with a product analytics tool or with IT asset, security, or infrastructure data

AI-Specific Skills

Lansweeper is an AI-native company. In this role, AI fluency is a hard requirement — not a nice-to-have.

You are expected to use AI tooling as a standard part of your day-to-day workflow: this includes AI-assisted SQL generation and debugging, using AI to accelerate data modelling and anomaly investigation, and leveraging AI features within your tech stack. You should be comfortable prompting AI tools effectively, evaluating their outputs critically, and integrating AI into repeatable workflows — from data pipeline development to drafting documentation, data tests, and lineage descriptions. General AI fluency is expected.

Team Info

You’ll join the Data & Analytics team, part of the broader Insights & Intelligence function at Lansweeper. Within the data team, you’ll collaborate daily with data analysts, data architects and fellow data engineers, so the models you build fit into a platform that is consistent and well governed.

Outside the data team, your main stakeholders will depend on your track. Revenue Analytics works closely with sales operations and finance, while Product Insights works with product management and customer success. Either way, you’ll be the link between those business teams and our data platform.

You’ll be one of two engineers joining to build out these domains, with real ownership of your area end-to-end. It’s a rare opportunity to shape how a growing SaaS company understands and steers both its revenue and its product.

The team is based across Ghent, Belgium and Alicante, Spain, with a hybrid working model at both locations.

BEDRIJF:

Dit Belgische SaaS-bedrijf ontwikkelt een commercieel platform dat dagelijks door duizenden professionals wordt gebruikt en complexe operationele en financiële processen overzichtelijk maakt.

De organisatie staat aan het begin van een centralisatie naar één schaalbaar dataplatform. Waarbij data en AI een grote strategische en commerciële waarde heeft naar de verdere expansie binnen de EU.

Je komt terecht in een compact technologieteam waar je rechtstreeks samenwerkt met product en development. Het bedrijf combineert de ondernemingsmentaliteit en korte beslissingslijnen van een scale-up met de financiële slagkracht van een grotere groep. Met verdere internationale groei in het vooruitzicht krijg je de kans om mee te bepalen hoe het datalandschap van morgen eruitziet.

JOBOMSCHRIJVING:

Als Data Engineer neem je ownership over het volledige dataplatform van een groeiend SaaS-product in volle Europese expansie. Je krijgt de vrijheid om de toekomstige data-architectuur mee te bepalen, technische keuzes te maken en een schaalbaar, futureproof dataplatform uit te bouwen.

Je werkt breed en end-to-end. Je brengt databronnen samen in één centrale omgeving, bouwt schaalbare datapipelines en ontwikkelt herbruikbare datamodellen volgens een medallion architecture. Daarbij werk je met technologieën zoals Azure, Snowflake en open-sourcecomponenten.

Je kijkt verder dan de bestaande architectuur en neemt het initiatief om het datalandschap te moderniseren. Je optimaliseert processen, verhoogt de datakwaliteit en krijgt op termijn de kans om een mogelijke migratie naar Microsoft Fabric mee vorm te geven.

Wat deze rol extra interessant maakt, is dat jouw werk rechtstreeks bijdraagt aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het SaaS-product. De data-infrastructuur die je bouwt, vormt de basis voor nieuwe analyticsfunctionaliteiten waarmee klanten meer inzicht krijgen in hun eigen gegevens. Je werkt hiervoor nauw samen met developers, product owners en de business, waardoor je niet alleen technisch veel vrijheid krijgt, maar ook rechtstreeks impact hebt op de toekomst van het product.

JOUW PROFIEL:

Voor deze rol kijken we uit naar een ondernemende Data Engineer die graag ownership neemt en mee wil bouwen aan de toekomst van een groeiend platform. Je technische basis is belangrijk, maar vooral je persoonlijkheid, initiatief en zin voor ownership maken het verschil.

Concreet breng je mee:

2 à 3 jaar ervaring met Data Engineering.
Goede kennis van Python en SQL.
Ervaring met het bouwen en onderhouden van datapipelines en datamodellen.
Ervaring met cloudomgevingen, idealiter Azure en/of Snowflake.
Interesse in data-architectuur.
Je bent ondernemend, denkt proactief mee en durft zelfstandig technische keuzes te maken.
Je neemt ownership, communiceert vlot en voelt je thuis in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt.
Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands.

UNIEK KARAKTER:

Je combineert de ondernemersmentaliteit van een scale-up met de financiële slagkracht van een sterke investeringsgroep. Het bedrijf staat aan het begin van een nieuwe groeifase, met grote ambities binnen Europa en volop ruimte om het dataplatform verder uit te bouwen.

Je komt niet terecht in een omgeving waar alle technische keuzes en processen al vastliggen. Integendeel, je krijgt de vrijheid om te experimenteren, initiatief te nemen en zelf richting te geven aan de toekomstige data-architectuur. Dankzij de korte beslissingslijnen kun je ideeën ook snel omzetten in concrete oplossingen.

Bovendien bouw je mee aan een SaaS-product in een sector met een enorm digitaliseringspotentieel. De nauwe samenwerking met product en business zorgt ervoor dat je rechtstreeks inspeelt op de noden van klanten. Zo zie je jouw technische werk vertaald worden naar slimmere systemen, nieuwe functionaliteiten en tastbare impact op het product

DESOTEC, founded in 1990, is the leading provider of mobile filtration solutions in Europe
and has been building a strong and growing presence in the United States

and the extensive expertise built up over many decades, DESOTEC unburdens its industrial customers and helps industries grow and thrive while reducing the environmental impact of their operations.

worldwide
, all committed to helping protect the planet by driving positive ecological change
across industries. In 2026, DESOTEC earned its second consecutive EcoVadis Gold
rating for sustainability, placing it among the top 5% of companies assessed worldwide.

Further information is available at www.desotec.com. Follow @desotec on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram

Your tasks & responsibilities?

At DESOTEC, we are on an ambitious growth journey, expanding internationally and scaling our operations across multiple markets. As data becomes increasingly critical in driving smart decisions, operational excellence and innovation, we are currently looking for a Data Engineer to help build and maintain the foundations of our data ecosystem. You will develop scalable data solutions, ensure reliable data availability across the organization and contribute to transforming data into actionable insights. This is a unique opportunity to leave your mark on a fast-growing, purpose-driven international company.

Power BI Platform & Architecture Approach: You help shape and support a scalable Power BI platform, ensuring that reporting solutions are built on trusted data, well-structured semantic models and clear governance principles. You contribute to the evolution of the data architecture by aligning Power BI datasets, dataflows and reporting standards with business needs, security requirements and long-term maintainability. You actively support a future-proof BI environment that enables both reliable management reporting and controlled self-service analytics across the organization.
Business Intelligence Enablement: You work closely with business stakeholders, IT colleagues and reporting experts to understand data requirements and translate them into sustainable technical solutions to maximize reporting effectiveness.
Data Modeling & Integration: You design, build and maintain robust data models that support business intelligence and analytics use cases. You manage data transformations and integration logic, ensuring consistency and efficiency across the data landscape.
Data Quality & Reliability: You monitor and improve data quality, integrity and performance across the entire data platform. You proactively identify and resolve issues to guarantee trustworthy and decision-ready data.

Who are you?

You hold a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g. Data, IT, Engineering, Computer Science or similar).
You are highly proficient in Englishand can communicate effectively with colleagues, stakeholders and leadership teams across our local and international operations. Knowledge of Dutch is considered a strong advantage.
You bring solid experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar data-focused role, working with modern data platforms and integration technologies.
You possess strong SQL expertise and have experience developing, optimizing and troubleshooting complex data solutions.
You have hands-on experience with Azure Data Platform technologies, Data Lakes, ETL/ELT processes and data modeling.

You are a hands-on technical specialist who enjoys solving complex problems and working collaboratively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You communicate clearly and work effectively with colleagues across business and IT functions to deliver impactful data solutions.

If you can't tick off all the boxes, but you do recognize yourself in our three core values Teamwork, Excellence and Devotion, then we definitely invite you to take a chance and apply!

What does your team look like?

As a Data Engineer
, you will be part of DESOTEC's growing data organization and work closely together with data and reporting professionals. You will report to our Data Lead and collaborate closely with BI developers, business stakeholders and IT teams to build and maintain a reliable and future-proof data ecosystem.

You operate at Group level, supporting multiple countries and entities, and play a key role in ensuring data is readily available, reliable and scalable across the organization.

What's in it for you?

It goes without saying that you get a lot in return in exchange for your unbridled dedication and enthusiasm:

A competitive salary: We guarantee you a (more than) competitive base salary, depending on your experience.
Fringe benefits: To optimize your salary package, you can count on: a company car with charging card, a smartphone with a mobile subscription, a generous net expense reimbursement, meal vouchers, group and hospitalization insurance (AG Insurance), a non-recurrent CAO90 bonus, two annual gross bonuses, and the option for bicycle leasing after 6 months of service.
Flexible compensation plan: You can convert part of your end-of-year bonus into benefits that suit your lifestyle, such as extra leave, multimedia, or a lease bike. This gives you the freedom to take control of your reward package and personalize it in a way that truly works for you, all within the applicable legal framework.
Work-life-balance / hybrid working: You work during flexible hours and get the freedom to spend 2 days a week in your home office after a training period. This flexible working arrangement allows you to start your workday in a relaxed manner, avoiding the morning rush, and to enjoy a high level of autonomy.
Time off to schedule freely: At DESOTEC there is no collective closure. You enjoy 29 paid vacation days and have the freedom to take 10 unpaid vacation days on top of that. This way you can increase your number of vacation days to 39 days!
Personal & professional growth: You will have every opportunity to immerse yourself in your new role, but also to grow personally and professionally through an extensive range of training courses.
Stay active & social: As an employee with a permanent contract, you can enjoy one free group sport lesson/activity per week at the Vision 21 gym in Roeselare, including activities like boxing, pilates, spinning, padel and more.
Discounts through partnerships: Through Benefits at Work you get discounts at Center Parcs, Zalando, bol.com, Krëfel, Decathlon and many more.
Fun and relaxation: You will regularly be invited to one of the many afterworks and other fun activities. Each team also gets a team building budget – it's up to you how you spend it!
Structured onboarding: We prepare a tailored onboarding plan for every new starter, ensuring a smooth integration into your team, tools, and DESOTEC’s mission from day one.

new_jobs.title: Databricks Data Engineer
new_jobs.description:
About Devoteam:

Devoteam is a leading consulting firm focused on digital transformation. We help our clients leverage technology to achieve their business goals. Our longstanding partnerships with leaders like AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft, and ServiceNow
amplify our capabilities, allowing us to deliver top-tier expertise and award-winning services.

For 30 years, we have always been on the next tech wave
. Devoteam has guided organizations through the Internet and cloud. The next revolution? AI.

With 11,000 tech natives working in 25+ countries, we bring you highly skilled IT experts across Europe

At Devoteam, tech is in our DNA
, and it’s the people we empower with tech. Now, with responsible AI, we’re ready to unlock a future where technology drives positive change.

Job Description

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and passionate Databricks Data Engineer to join our expanding Data & AI team Databricks Partner (50 FTE)
. In this role, you will be a crucial player in designing, building, and maintaining cutting-edge data solutions on the Databricks platform. You will have the opportunity to work with a variety of clients across different industries, collaborating with both internal teams and client stakeholders to deliver high-quality data pipelines and enable data-driven decision-making.

Responsibilities:

Data Pipeline Engineering: Design, develop, and deploy robust and scalable data pipelines using Databricks, incorporating data extraction from diverse sources (databases, APIs, streaming platforms), transformation and cleansing using Spark, and loading into target systems (data lakes, data warehouses, etc.). Optimize pipeline performance for efficiency and cost-effectiveness.
Databricks Ecosystem Expertise: Utilize the full capabilities of the Databricks platform, including Databricks SQL, Delta Lake, Databricks Runtime, and Databricks Workflows, to orchestrate complex data workflows and ensure data quality and pipeline reliability.
Cloud Integration: Seamlessly integrate Databricks with cloud services (Azure, AWS, or GCP) for storage, compute, and security, leveraging services like Azure Data Lake Storage, AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, and more.
Data Architecture and Modeling: Contribute to the design and implementation of robust data models and architectures for data lakes and data warehouses, ensuring data consistency, integrity, and accessibility for various use cases.
Data Quality Assurance: Implement rigorous data quality checks and validation procedures throughout the data pipeline to maintain high accuracy and reliability. Adhere to data governance policies and best practices.
Collaboration and Communication: Work closely with data scientists, analysts, business intelligence specialists, and business stakeholders to understand their data requirements and provide technical expertise on Databricks and data engineering best practices.
Continuous Learning: Stay up to date with the latest Databricks features, cloud technologies, and data engineering trends to continuously improve our solutions and deliver innovative results for our clients.

Qualifications

Qualifications :

Hold a University Degree in Computer Science, (Business) Engineering, or a specialized master's in Machine Learning or AI.
Proven Experience: 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer with demonstrated expertise in Databricks.
Cloud Proficiency: Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), with a good understanding of cloud data services and infrastructure.
Programming Skills: Strong programming skills in Python or Scala, with experience in data manipulation libraries (e.g., PySpark, Spark SQL).
Data Fundamentals: Solid understanding of data warehousing principles, ETL processes, data modeling techniques, and database systems.
SQL Expertise: Advanced SQL skills for data querying, transformation, and analysis.
Communication Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving data-related challenges.
Fluent in English and proficiency in Dutch or French is mandatory.

Bonus Points :

Experience with machine learning or AI technologies.
Knowledge of DevOps practices.
Contributions to open-source projects.
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).

Additional Information

Why choose us?

Thrive in a fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment
Work with innovative and impactful Cloud, Data & AI projects for industry-leading clients
Connect with extraordinary talents in a collaborative and diverse culture
Enjoy a healthy work-life balance in an inspiring, eco-friendly workplace
Competitive compensation package

At Devoteam, we combine strong values – respect, frankness, ambition, entrepreneurship & collaboration – with a fun and supportive environment that empowers you to innovate, grow, and succeed in the fast-paced world of Cloud, Data & AI.

new_jobs.title: Cloud & Data engineer
new_jobs.description:
Jouw functie

Breng je nieuwsgierigheid mee naar het werk als onze volgende Cloud & Data Engineer
. Je wordt onderdeel van ons gespecialiseerde softwareteam binnen Atlas Copco Airpower in Wilrijk en rapporteert aan de team leader. In deze functie is het jouw missie om als brug te fungeren tussen software engineering, data engineering en toegepaste data science, en om schaalbare cloudbackends, streaming datapiplines en AI-gedreven diagnostische tools te bouwen die duizenden verbonden industriële compressoren wereldwijd optimaliseren.

Jouw dagelijkse werkzaamheden

Bouwen en schalen van het cloudplatform dat fysieke machinecontrollers in het veld verbindt met intelligente cloudservices voor vlootmonitoring, voorspellend onderhoud (predictive maintenance) en diagnostische inzichten.
Vloeibaar schakelen tussen het opzetten van streaming telemetriepipelines (Azure Data Explorer, Databricks, Event Hubs) en het ontwikkelen van machine learning-modellen voor anomaliedetectie en voorspelling van storingen.
Uitrollen van ML-modellen naar productie met driftmonitoring, schrijven van Infrastructure-as-Code (Bicep), bouwen van backend API's (C# / Python) en uitbreiden van agentic AI- en RAG-architecturen voor ongestructureerde technische kennis.
Nauw samenwerken met een multidisciplinair team van engineers en onderzoekers om ideeën via notebookprototypes en CI/CD-pipelines om te zetten in betrouwbare, productijpe services.
Deelnemen aan code reviews, technische afstemming en continue verbeterinitiatieven binnen het softwareteam.

Jouw vaardigheden en ervaring

Masterdiploma in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence of een aanverwant vakgebied (of gelijkwaardig door praktijkervaring).
1 tot 3 jaar hands-on ervaring in software engineering, datapiplelines en machine learning workflows.
Solide programmeervaardigheden in Python; werkende kennis van C# of de leergierigheid om dit snel op te pikken.
Praktische ervaring met cloudplatforms (bij voorkeur Azure), MLOps-tools (bijv. MLflow, Weights & Biases) en tijdreeksdataverwerking (ADX/Kusto, Spark, Databricks, SQL).
Vertrouwdheid met LLM-toepassingen, prompt engineering, RAG-architecturen, vector databanken en agentic frameworks (bijv. LangChain, Semantic Kernel).
Ervaring met moderne software engineering praktijken: Git, CI/CD, containerisering, Infrastructure-as-Code (Bicep) en code reviews; kennis van IoT-protocollen (MQTT, AMQP) of frontend frameworks is een pluspunt.
Nieuwsgierige, pragmatische en samenwerkingsgerichte instelling met een professionele beheersing van het Engels (mondeling en schriftelijk).

We moedigen je aan om te solliciteren, ook als je niet aan alle vereisten voldoet. We waarderen uiteenlopende ervaringen en perspectieven en zijn benieuwd wat jij meebrengt naar de functie.

Jouw beloning en arbeidsvoorwaarden

Bij Atlas Copco Group zetten we ons in voor een eerlijke en gelijkwaardige beloning. De beloning wordt bepaald op basis van de functie en de bijbehorende verantwoordelijkheden, zonder onderscheid naar gender, ras, etniciteit, religie, fysieke mogelijkheden, seksuele geaardheid, burgerlijke staat of enig ander beschermd kenmerk. Ons beloningsaanbod is ontworpen om lokaal relevant, competitief en afgestemd te zijn op de verwachtingen van huidig en toekomstig talent.

Het daadwerkelijke beloningspakket wordt bepaald op basis van objectieve, genderneutrale criteria, waaronder maar niet beperkt tot de kwalificaties, ervaring en vaardigheden die tijdens het wervingsproces worden aangetoond. Naast het basissalaris omvat deze functie een uitgebreid onboardingprogramma, inclusief begeleiding door een persoonlijke peter of meter. Je krijgt ook toegang tot wereldwijde carrièremogelijkheden als onderdeel van de Atlas Copco Group. Wij bieden een interessant pakket aan beloningen en secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder een ziekteverzekering, betaald verlof en pensioenvoorzieningen.

Naast beloning geloven we dat een waardevolle loopbaan draait om kansen om te leren, te groeien, bij te dragen en je te ontwikkelen in een omgeving die is gebouwd op vertrouwen, samenwerking en continue verbetering. Bij Atlas Copco Group ondersteunen we onze mensen bij het opbouwen van een duurzame loopbaan, terwijl ze met hun werk een betekenisvolle impact maken.

Jouw werklocatie

Deze functie biedt een hybride werkmodel, waarbij je je tijd kunt verdelen tussen werken op afstand en werken op locatie bij onze site in Wilrijk, België.

Waarom het fijn is om bij ons te werken

Je carrière groeit door je vaardigheden, je nieuwsgierigheid en de mensen met wie je samenwerkt. Je maakt deel uit van een wereldwijd netwerk waarin we van elkaar leren en kennis delen. We richten ons op ontwikkeling op de lange termijn en moedigen je aan om nieuwe ideeën te verkennen die ons vooruithelpen. Innovatie is ingebed in hoe we denken en handelen – we testen, verbeteren en gebruiken wat we leren om oplossingen te creëren die een verschil maken. Met jouw ideeën en verantwoordelijkheid kan jij impact maken. Wij ondersteunen jou met een flexibel arbeidsmodel en goed leiderschap.

Selectieproces

Ons selectieproces bestaat uit verschillende gesprekken en, voor sommige functies, vaardigheidstests die ons helpen om jouw profiel beter te begrijpen. We kijken er alvast naar uit om je te leren kennen, om meer te horen over jouw sterke punten en te bespreken hoe onze samenwerking eruit kan zien .

Uniting Curious Minds

Achter elke innovatie zitten mensen die samenwerken om de toekomst vorm te geven. Met carrières die bruisen van initiatief en levenslang leren, brengen wij curious minds samen en jij kan één van hen zijn.

new_jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer GCP
new_jobs.description:
Bij JUVO zijn mensen, data en technologie de kern van ons bestaan.
Onze consultants zijn experts in hun vakgebied en zorgen ervoor dat projecten bij onze klanten in goede banen worden geleid.
Ben jij een ervaren Data Engineer met een passie voor Google Cloud? Krijg je energie van het bouwen en optimaliseren van data pipelines en wil je meewerken aan een toekomstgerichte dataomgeving waarin ook AI een belangrijke rol speelt? Dan hebben wij een interessante freelanceopdracht voor jou!

Organisatie

Bij JUVO bundelen we onze expertise binnen de Data & AI unit
, waar we gespecialiseerd zijn in Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Data Analyse, Data Architectuur, Data Visualisatie en Data Strategie.
Voor een van onze klanten zijn we op zoek naar een ervaren Data Engineer met sterke expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
.
Je komt terecht in een internationaal datateam dat volop inzet op de verdere ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van zijn data-infrastructuur. Je werkt nauw samen met andere Data Engineers, Data Modeling-specialisten en een Data Analyst, onder leiding van de Head of Data.
De opdracht kan volledig remote
uitgevoerd worden, binnen een internationale en Engelstalige werkomgeving.

The JOB

Als Data Engineer speel je een belangrijke rol in de verdere uitbouw van een moderne, schaalbare en toekomstgerichte dataomgeving binnen Google Cloud.
De architecturale krijtlijnen zijn al uitgezet. Jij zorgt er met jouw technische expertise voor dat deze plannen worden omgezet in concrete, performante oplossingen.
Wat ga je concreet doen?

Je ontwikkelt, onderhoudt en optimaliseert data pipelines en integraties binnen Google Cloud Platform.
Je werkt intensief met BigQuery, Dataform, Google Cloud Run en Google Datastream
.
Je verbindt verschillende databronnen met het datawarehouse en zorgt ervoor dat data efficiënt beschikbaar wordt voor andere systemen, waaronder marketing automation en Google Ads.
Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt custom connectors en API-integraties.
Je optimaliseert het bestaande datawarehouse en draagt bij aan de verdere uitbreiding van de data-infrastructuur.
Je helpt de dataomgeving AI-ready
te maken door mee te bouwen aan een knowledge layer met duidelijke KPI-definities en gestructureerde en ongestructureerde data.
Je implementeert datakwaliteitscontroles en draagt bij aan een betrouwbare, goed gedocumenteerde dataomgeving.
Je werkt nauw samen met het bestaande datateam en neemt zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid voor de technische uitvoering.

Kortom, jij bent de hands-on expert die ervoor zorgt dat data niet alleen beschikbaar en betrouwbaar is, maar ook klaar is voor toekomstige AI-toepassingen.

Jouw skills

Google Cloud Platform:
Je hebt uitgebreide hands-on ervaring met GCP. BigQuery en Dataform zijn voor jou vertrouwde technologieën. Ervaring met Google Cloud Run en Google Datastream is een sterke troef.
Data Engineering:
Je hebt ruime ervaring met het ontwikkelen, onderhouden en optimaliseren van robuuste data pipelines en data-integraties.
Datawarehouse & Integraties:
Je weet hoe je verschillende databronnen samenbrengt en data efficiënt beschikbaar maakt voor andere applicaties en systemen.
API's & Connectors:
Je hebt ervaring met het ontwikkelen van custom connectors en API-integraties.
Data Governance & Quality:
Je hebt inzicht in datakwaliteit, metadata en het structureren en documenteren van data. Ervaring met Google Cloud Dataplex Universal Catalog is mooi meegenomen.
Marketing Data:
Ervaring met Segment (Twilio), Google Ads of marketing automation is een pluspunt.
AI-readiness:
Je hebt interesse in het voorbereiden van dataomgevingen voor AI-toepassingen. Ervaring met knowledge layers, KPI-definities of ongestructureerde data is een extra troef.
Ervaring & Zelfstandigheid:
Je bent een ervaren medior of senior Data Engineer die snel zelfstandig aan de slag kan en technische uitdagingen pragmatisch aanpakt.
Communicatie:
Je werkt graag samen in een internationaal team en communiceert vlot in het Engels.

We zoeken vooral een echte hands-on Data Engineer
die graag zelf bouwt, ontwikkelt en optimaliseert. Je denkt mee over technische oplossingen, maar haalt vooral voldoening uit het effectief realiseren ervan.

The OFFER

Een uitdagende freelanceopdracht binnen een internationale, datagedreven omgeving.
Een initiële projectduur van 6 maanden
.
De mogelijkheid om remote
te werken.
Samenwerking met een ervaren en internationaal verspreid datateam.
De kans om te werken met moderne Google Cloud-technologieën.
Een actieve rol in de verdere uitbouw van een data-infrastructuur en de voorbereiding op AI-toepassingen.
Een marktconform dagtarief, afgestemd op jouw ervaring en expertise.
Bij voorkeur een snelle opstart.

Klaar om jouw Google Cloud-expertise in te zetten voor een uitdagend dataproject?

Ben jij een ervaren Data Engineer die graag de handen uit de mouwen steekt en impact wil maken binnen een moderne dataomgeving?

Dan komen we bij JUVO graag met jou in contact!

new_jobs.title: Data Engineer, WW Ops Finance S&A
new_jobs.description:
Description

Are you passionate about standardizing data platforms and automating data engineering to drive analytics and reporting? Do you excel in dynamic, fast-paced environments and find joy in converting data into actionable insights? Are you adept at implementing data governance practices and defining data access and quality standards? If you thrive in innovation and can deliver scalable Data Engineering Solutions, then the Worldwide Operations Finance Standardization & Automation (S&A) team has an exciting opportunity for you! We are seeking a customer-centric Data Engineer to establish a reliable and accessible data platform, ensuring Operations Finance customers have complete trust in the data, technology, and tools to make data-driven business decisions. We are looking for a Data Engineer to be part of our Global Data Delivery organization, working with one of the world's largest and most complex data warehouse environments.

As a Data Engineer in WW Ops S&A, you will design, implement and support scalable data infrastructure solutions and implement complex data models for Amazon Customer Fulfillment business. You will create solutions to integrate with multi heterogeneous data sources, aggregate and retrieve data in a fast and safe mode, curate data that can be used in reporting, analysis, GenAI models and ad-hoc data requests. You should have excellent business and communication skills to be able to work with business owners, Finance and Product teams along with tech leaders to gather infrastructure requirements, design data infrastructure, build up data pipelines and data-sets to meet business needs. You will be responsible for developing and operating a data service platform using Python, Airflow, and SQL to build various ETL, analytics, and data quality components. You'll automate deployments using AWS CodeDeploy, AWS CodePipeline, AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK), and AWS Cloud Formation. You will work with AWS services like Redshift, Glue, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, and more. Strong experience in Data Warehouse and Business Intelligence application development, expert knowledge in SQL query optimization, and experience with programming languages such as Scala/Python are essential for this role.

Key job responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain complex data solutions and ETL pipelines using Python, Spark, SQL, and AWS services (S3, Glue, Redshift, MWAA, EMR, Lambda)
Develop high-quality data architecture and scalable pipelines to support customer reporting needs, while implementing and supporting analytics infrastructure for internal Finance customers
Interface with technology teams to extract, transform, and load data from various sources, ensuring data quality and making appropriate trade-offs in design decisions
Collaborate with business users, developers, and BI Engineers to deliver on data architecture projects and next-generation financial solutions
Actively participate in code reviews, design discussions, and team planning, while continually improving reporting processes and automating self-service support
Identify and implement process improvements to drive innovation, scale existing solutions, and create new ones based on stakeholder needs
Diagnose and resolve operational issues through detailed root cause analysis, maintaining high standards of system availability and reliability

About The Team

The Operations finance data ecosystem supports global data management solutions inclusive of the scaling solutions to support 10+ data producer teams and 2500 finance customers. The role will work with BIE/DE teams across the organization, identifying critical customer pain points and help design , implement and drive customer's data journey. In the age of AI capabilities, the role will identify newer mechanisms to help incorporate AI driven workflows both for our builder and customer communities.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of data engineering experience
Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
Bachelor's degree
Experience in at least one modern scripting or programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or NodeJS
Knowledge of distributed systems as it pertains to data storage and computing

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)
Experience building large-scale, high-throughput, 24x7 data systems

new_jobs.description:
Join us at Orange Business!

We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.

Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.

À propos du rôle

Contexte

Dans le cadre du renforcement de l’équipe en charge de la mise en place de la plateforme Data de notre client, fondée sur une architecture Lakehouse, nous cherchons un Data Engineer confirmé. L’intervenant conçoit, développe, industrialise et maintient les flux d’ingestion et de transformation, contribue à la structuration des couches Bronze, Silver et Gold et prépare des jeux de données fiables pour les usages métiers et décisionnels.

Conception et transformation des données
Concevoir, développer et maintenir les flux de transformation de données avec dbt
Développer en Python les traitements d’ingestion et de préparation des données
Contribuer à la mise en place des couches Bronze, Silver et Gold de la plateforme Lakehouse
Orchestration et industrialisation
Développer et maintenir les DAGs Airflow pour orchestrer les traitements de données

new_jobs.title: Data Engineer (H/F)
new_jobs.description:
SMILE
est le leader du "sourire" au travail, mais aussi de l'intégration de solutions Open-Source
. Enthousiastes, agiles et performants, notre vocation est de libérer le potentiel d'innovation des entreprises, à travers l'Open-Source !

Nos Smiliens experts accompagnent les entreprises dans des domaines aussi variés que le Digital, les Business Apps, l'Embarqué & l'IoT et l'Infrastructure : 2000 collaborateurs présents dans 9 pays, avec 17 agences réparties en France et à l'international. Nos marques expertes : SensioLabs, Neopixl, Alter Way, UX-Republic, Creativestyle et Synotis.

Nous sommes certifiés “Happy at Work” 2023 !😍

Au sein de l'agence située à Casablanca, rejoignez une équipe dynamique de passionnés du monde Open Source, dans une ambiance à taille humaine.

Nous cherchons un(e) Data Engineer qui peut nous aider à évaluer la qualité, l'exactitude et l'exhaustivité des sources de données et des produits numériques.

Vos responsabilités :

Concevoir, développer et maintenir des pipelines de données robustes et scalables.
Intégrer et transformer des données issues de sources multiples (APIs, bases de

données, fichiers, systèmes tiers).

Optimiser la performance et la qualité des flux de données (monitoring, logging,

gestion des erreurs).

Mettre en place des mécanismes de gestion de la qualité et de la sécurité des données.
Participer à la conception de l’architecture Data (stockage, ingestion, transformation,

restitution).

Implémenter et administrer des solutions Cloud/Data Warehouse (Snowflake, Azure

Blob Storage, etc.).

Automatiser les workflows de données avec des orchestrateurs (Airflow, dbt, etc.).
Travailler étroitement avec les Data Scientists et Analystes pour rendre les données

prêtes à l’analyse.

Contribuer à l’intégration des modèles de Machine Learning et d’analyses avancées

dans les pipelines.

Documenter et partager les bonnes pratiques d’ingénierie des données au sein de

l’équipe.

Environnement technique:

Langages & outils de traitement de données : Python, SQL (DBT), Spark, Bash.
Orchestration & ETL : expérience avec Airflow ou outils similaires.
Bases de données : maîtrise des systèmes relationnels et NoSQL.
Cloud & Data Warehouse : expérience avec Snowflake, Azure (Blob Storage), ou équivalent.
Visualisation : la maîtrise de Power BI est un plus.
Maitrise des outils de CI/CD/Git
Connaissances des environnements Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) est un atout.
Bonne compréhension des architectures orientées données (Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Data Mesh).

Qualifications :

Vous avez un Bac+5 en Data Science, Statistiques, Informatique ou un domaine similaire.
Vous avez 2 ans d'expérience en analyse, gestion et/ou qualité de la donnée.
Vous avez des excellentes capacités d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes.
Vous avez une autonomie et capacité à travailler sur des projets complexes.
Vous avez un esprit d’équipe et bonnes compétences en communication.

Envoyez-nous vite votre CV, ce poste est pour vous !

new_jobs.description:
Le Groupe SII vous attend !

Nous recherchons un Développeur Talend Big Data (H/F) chez SII Le Mans.

Missions et responsabilités

Contribuez à l’évolution et au maintien en conditions opérationnelles de solutions de traitement de données. Vous interviendrez de l’analyse des besoins à la mise en production, dans un environnement associant Talend, SQL et les technologies Big Data.

Analyser les spécifications fonctionnelles et rédiger les spécifications techniques nécessaires aux développements.
Implémenter de nouvelles fonctionnalités et développer les flux d’intégration de données avec Talend.
Concevoir et optimiser les requêtes SQL pour améliorer les performances des traitements.
Participer aux recettes techniques et fonctionnelles, analyser les anomalies et mettre en œuvre les corrections.
Assurer la maintenance et le support des solutions déployées.
Prendre en charge les activités de RUN dans un environnement SQL, Spark, Hive, Cloudera, Java, HBase et Talend : suivre les traitements, diagnostiquer les incidents et contribuer à leur résolution.
Rédiger et maintenir la documentation technique pour faciliter l’exploitation, la maintenance et le partage des connaissances.

Profil recherché

Vous disposez d’une expérience en développement et en maintenance de solutions d’intégration et de traitement de données.
Vous maîtrisez Talend pour concevoir et faire évoluer des flux de données, ainsi que SQL pour écrire et optimiser des requêtes.
Vous connaissez les environnements Big Data intégrant Spark, Hive, Cloudera et HBase, et possédez des compétences en Java.
Vous savez traduire des besoins fonctionnels en spécifications techniques et en développements testables.
Vous savez diagnostiquer un incident de production, en analyser les causes et assurer la traçabilité des corrections.
Vous échangez avec les équipes fonctionnelles et techniques pour clarifier les besoins, préparer les recettes et partager les informations utiles au support.

new_jobs.description:
About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

Team

Our Corporate teams support the company's performance and growth whilst putting people at the core of everything they do. As a French tech leader and global successful company, our Corporate teams are constantly looking for ways to innovate and increase organisation efficiency to keep Voodoo ahead of the market. Voodoo's Corporate function is composed of three teams: HR, Legal and Finance, working together to drive Voodoo's success.

As Voodoo continues to grow, we are transforming the way Finance uses data and technology. Our ambition is to move from fragmented, spreadsheet-heavy workflows to a modern, reliable, and increasingly automated Finance data platform.

Role

We're looking for a Finance Data Engineer
to join our Corporate team. In this role, you'll own the technical transformation of Finance by building the data foundations, pipelines, and internal tools that enable Finance teams to operate more efficiently and make better decisions.

Reporting to the CFO, you will work closely with Finance stakeholders and Voodoo's central Data team, combining data engineering, business understanding, and product thinking to turn complex Finance needs into reliable and maintainable solutions.

Define and drive the roadmap for Finance data, automation, and internal tooling
Build and progressively scale Voodoo's Finance data platform, prioritising the use cases that create the greatest business value
Migrate critical data transformations and workflows from spreadsheets and legacy tools to tested, documented, code-based solutions
Create reliable data models and pipelines for Finance reporting, analysis, forecasting, and operational processes
Establish strong standards for data quality, observability, documentation, security, and access management
Partner closely with Accounting, FP&A, Controlling, Treasury, and other Finance stakeholders to translate their needs into scalable technical solutions
Collaborate regularly with Voodoo's Data leadership and engineering teams to align on architecture, tooling, and best practices
Build intuitive dashboards and internal applications that allow Finance teams to explore data and manage workflows independently
Identify AI and automation opportunities, take them from prototype to production, and measure the value they create
Help Finance teams adopt data and AI tools effectively through documentation, training, and day-to-day support

Profile

Significant experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related role, including ownership of production-grade data solutions
Proven track record of building or substantially improving a modern data platform or analytics stack
Highly proficient in SQL and comfortable building production systems in Python
Strong software-engineering practices applied to data work: testing, version control, code review, documentation, and monitoring
Solid understanding of core corporate Finance and accounting concepts; familiarity with French accounting principles is a strong advantage
Ability to translate ambiguous business needs into clear, pragmatic technical solutions
Comfortable working autonomously, prioritising competing needs, and delivering value incrementally
Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, in French and English
Curious about the evolving data and AI ecosystem — you test new approaches on real problems and form your own point of view
Rigorous, detail-oriented, and focused on measurable outcomes; pragmatic in technology choices, knowing when to build, adopt open-source, or buy commercial solutions

Nice To Have

Experience building tools or data products for Finance teams
Experience deploying AI agents or AI-enabled workflows into production
Familiarity with the mobile gaming, consumer apps, advertising, or digital analytics ecosystem
Experience operating data infrastructure on AWS

Our Stack

Cloud: AWS
Languages: Python, SQL, Scala
Transformation & orchestration: dbt, Airflow, Spark
Query engines: Athena, StarRocks
Infrastructure: Terraform, Kubernetes
Internal applications: Streamlit
AI-assisted development: Claude Code, MCP-based internal tooling

Benefits

Competitive salary based on experience
Swile Lunch voucher
Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)
Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family
Wellness activities in our Paris office
Remote Fridays

afin d'accompagner nos clients dans la conception, le développement et l'industrialisation de leurs plateformes de données.

Concevoir, développer et maintenir les pipelines de collecte, transformation et valorisation des données.
Participer à la mise en place et à l'évolution des architectures Data modernes.
Industrialiser les traitements de données et automatiser les processus d'intégration.
Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et la disponibilité des données.
Optimiser les performances des traitements et des plateformes Data.
Participer à la définition des modèles de données et des bonnes pratiques de développement.

Contribuer aux démarches de gouvernance, de sécurisation et de valorisation de la donnée.
Participer aux projets de modernisation des plateformes Data ainsi qu'aux initiatives autour de l'IA et du Machine Learning.

De formation supérieure en informatique, data ou équivalent, vous justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience
en tant que Data Engineer.

Expérience dans la conception, le développement et l'industrialisation de pipelines de données.
Maîtrise de SQL et Python pour le traitement, la transformation et la valorisation des données.

Expérience sur des environnements Cloud, idéalement GCP, et connaissance des bonnes pratiques d'industrialisation et d'automatisation.
Connaissance des concepts et cas d'usage liés à l'Intelligence Artificielle et au Machine Learning.

Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, nous recherchons une personne :

Dotée d'un excellent esprit d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes.

Rigoureuse, organisée et soucieuse de la qualité des données produites.
Autonome, proactive et force de proposition.

Curieuse et motivée par les évolutions du monde de la Data et de l'IA.

SII Auvergne Rhône-Alpes s’est imposé comme acteur majeur des technologies de l’information et des services informatiques depuis 2002 et compte actuellement plus de 230 collaborateurs.

L’agence principale de la région est située à Lyon en plein cœur du quartier des affaires de la Part-Dieu (3e arrondissement)

Fort d’une présence stratégique dans plusieurs villes clés de la région, notamment Lyon, Grenoble et Clermont-Ferrand, SII est idéalement situé pour accompagner une trentaine de clients grands comptes principalement dans les secteurs des Télécoms, de l’Energie, de l’Industrie, de la Finance et des Transports.

Nous couvrons des domaines d'expertise variés : Infrastructure/Systèmes, Gestion de projet Agile, Développement logiciel, Test, Devops et Cyber et intervenons auprès de nos clients en Assistante Technique ou en Delivery Structuré (mode projet, centre de services)

Le groupe SII est au cœur de l’innovation au service de grands comptes dans des secteurs d’ingénierie variés. En 2026, pour la 9ème année consécutive, SII France a obtenu le label Great Place To Work®.

Cette promesse représente notre ambition commune : construire un futur technologique ensemble, dans un cadre où l'expérimentation et l'autonomie sont encouragées, où les innovations sont au cœur de nos actions, et où chaque collaborateur trouve épanouissement professionnel et responsabilisation au sein d'un collectif enthousiaste et inclusif.

The world is how we shape it*

Le monde est tel que nous le façonnons

Vous êtes passionné(e) par la valorisation de la donnée, rejoignez notre Data Factory localisée à Paris ! Vous y rencontrerez des experts de la mise en œuvre de Plateforme de Données, des Data Architectes ou autres experts solution autour des problématiques de valorisation de la donnée.

Vous êtes accompagné(e) au développement de vos connaissances aux travers de différents parcours Data que ce soit pour l'ingestion, la construction de datahub, la transformation et valorisation de la donnée, la modélisation et mise à disposition.

Rejoindre notre Data Factory Sopra Steria, c'est rejoindre une communauté de Data Ingénieurs fiers de partager leur savoir et ouverts aux nouvelles expériences et expérimentations de la donnée.

Votre rôle et vos missions :

Dans le cadre de la mise en place du centre Data pour un grand acteur financier de l’état et selon votre appétence, vous participerez à plusieurs étapes de la chaîne :

La compréhension des besoins métiers et la traduction solution de data ingénierie
La mise en œuvre de solution d'ingestion des données quelles soit en batch et/ou en streaming dans un contexte Cloud ;
La structuration du DataLake, la mise en place de processus de gouvernance et sécurisation des données ;
Le traitement de la donnée jusqu'à l'exposition au métier ;
La mise en place de la chaine CI/CD et de sa supervision ;
La veille technologie avec nos partenaires éditeurs et la mise en place de Prototype Design, Proof of Concept ou encore MVP dans un objectif d'idéation pour nos clients.

Vous maitrisez un langage de programmation appliqué à l’analyse de données (SQL, Scala, R, Python, Java), le traitement distribué de données (Spark, Pyspark , Hadoop) et un Framework de streaming de données (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).

Qualifications

Vous êtes attiré(e) par le monde du numérique, le Cloud et des technologies innovantes.

Vous avez un bon esprit d'analyse, êtes curieux(se) et passionné(e) et vous avez le sens du travail en équipe dans une organisation Agile type Srcum ou SAFE

Vous accordez une importance particulière au développement de vos compétences sur plusieurs technologies. Vous souhaitez une évolution réelle de carrière à travers l'expérience projet. Vous êtes soucieux de l'apport de valeur pour vos clients. Et vous voulez transmettre votre savoir auprès de collaborateurs moins expérimentés. Alors, n'attendez-plus, ce poste est fait pour vous !

Diplômé(e) d'une Ecole d'ingénieur ou formation équivalente, vous avez déjà participé à un projet Data (Big Data, BI) et vous avez une expérience de minimum 3 ans.

La maitrise de Dataiku serait un plus.

Informations supplémentaires

Un accord télétravail pour télétravailler jusqu’à 2 jours par semaine selon vos missions.
Un package avantages intéressant : une mutuelle, un CSE, des titres restaurants, un accord d’intéressement, des primes vacances et cooptation.
Des opportunités de carrières multiples : plus de 30 familles de métiers, autant de passerelles à imaginer ensemble.
Plusieurs centaines de formations accessibles en toute autonomie avec Sopra Steria Academy.
La possibilité de s’engager auprès d’une association grâce à notre plateforme d’engagement citoyen.
L'opportunité de rejoindre le collectif Tech'Me UP (formations, conférences, veille, et bien plus encore…).

Employeur inclusif et engagé, notre société œuvre chaque jour pour lutter contre toute forme de discrimination et favoriser un environnement de travail respectueux. C’est pourquoi, attachés à la mixité et à la diversité, nous encourageons toutes les candidatures et tous les profils.

Data is de motor van elke digitale transformatie. Werk je graag mee aan de meest innovatieve data oplossingen van de toekomst? Dan heeft Cegeka de uitdaging voor jou! We zijn binnen ons Data & AI team binnen Cegeka op zoek naar een Snowflake Data Engineer. Als expert op het gebied van Snowflake zal je een cruciale rol spelen binnen onze uitdagende Snowflake projecten. Wij hanteren hierbij steeds een “Public Cloud First” Strategie. Naast ons partnership met Snowflake zijn we ook Microsoft- en Databricks-partner. Heb je zin om ons team van specialisten te vervoegen? Solliciteer dan zeker en laat je talent en ervaring bijdragen aan onze missie!

In je rol als Snowflake Data Engineer werk je nauw samen met collega's aan data- en AI-projecten voor bedrijven in verschillende sectoren.
Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt robuuste, schaalbare ELT-pipelines met dbt (ook native via dbt Projects on Snowflake), georkestreerd met Apache Airflow of Snowflake Tasks, Streams en Dynamic Tables, met een sterke focus op automatisering en herbruikbaarheid.
Je ontsluit data uit bronsystemen met Snowpipe (Streaming) en Snowflake Openflow / Apache NiFi, en transformeert die volgens de business logica tot betrouwbare datamodellen op het centrale dataplatform. Datakwaliteit en robuustheid staan centraal.
Je bouwt mee aan open lakehouse-architecturen met Apache Iceberg tables en Iceberg-catalogs (Horizon Catalog, Snowflake Open Catalog/Polaris).
Je ondersteunt domeinteams volgens data mesh-principes en ontsluit data products via secure data sharing en het Internal Marketplace.
Je bewaakt governance (RBAC, masking en row access policies, tagging) en performance en kosten (warehouse-sizing, resource monitors, query profiling).
Je automatiseert deployments via CI/CD en gebruikt CoCo (Cortex Code) om sneller en beter te ontwikkelen.
Je vertaalt functionele en technische requirements naar concrete dataoplossingen.
Cegeka is Snowflake-partner. Dit geeft je rechtstreeks toegang tot hun solution architects bij technische uitdagingen of specifieke vragen.

Wat breng jij mee?

Je hebt ruime ervaring als Data Engineer of in een hands-on datarol binnen complexe enterprise-omgevingen.
Je werkt dagelijks met Snowflake en beheerst SQL en Python (Snowpark).
Je hebt hands-on ervaring met dbt en met orkestratie via Airflow of Snowflake Tasks en Dynamic Tables.
Je hebt ervaring met data-integratie via Snowpipe en Snowflake Openflow / Apache NiFi.
Je bent vertrouwd met Apache Iceberg tables en Iceberg-catalogs (Horizon Catalog, Snowflake Open Catalog/Polaris, catalog integrations met bv. AWS Glue of Unity Catalog).
Je kent multi-cloud omgevingen (Azure, AWS) en integreert die met Snowflake (storage integrations, external volumes, private connectivity).
Je werkt met CI/CD: versiebeheer in Git, geautomatiseerde deployments met Snowflake CLI en/of Terraform, en testen in de pipeline.
Je bent vertrouwd met Snowflake CoCo (Cortex Code), de AI-codingagent van Snowflake.
Je kent Snowflake-governance en -kostenbeheer (RBAC, masking en row access policies, warehouse-sizing, resource monitors).
Je hebt een stevige achtergrond in datamodellering (Data Vault, Kimball) en past die schaalbaar en onderhoudbaar toe in productie.
Een bepaalde flexibiliteit naar verplaatsingen is vereist aangezien er regelmatig van bij de klant wordt gewerkt. Als je aanwezigheid bij de klant niet vereist is dan kan je in het Cegeka-kantoor dichtst bij je woonplaats werken (Antwerpen, Brussel, Gent, Hasselt of Leuven) in combinatie met thuiswerk.
Pluspunten: SnowPro Core / SnowPro Advanced: Data Engineer.
Je beschikt over uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in het Engels. Kennis van het Nederlands en Frans zijn een grote meerwaarde.

Wat hebben wij jou te bieden?

Je komt terecht bij een echte Top Employer.
Cegeka bewijst jaar na jaar in het Whitelane Research dat we een betrouwbare en toonaangevende partner zijn op vlak van IT-dienstverlening, met een eerste plaats in 2026 voor Security Services (vierde jaar op rij), een gedeelde tweede plaats voor Cloud & Infrastructure Services en Network & Connectivity.

Wij hanteren een framework met het oog op eerlijke verloning, waarbij medewerkers worden verloond op basis van hun functie, ervaring en prestaties, onafhankelijk van gender of andere niet-werkgerelateerde kenmerken. Een elektrische wagen met laadpas of een mobiliteitsbudget, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, een interessante groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering, een gsm-abonnement, een forfaitaire onkostenvergoeding, een krachtige laptop en de mogelijkheid om je salarispakket een eigen accent te geven dankzij ons Flex Reward Plan.
Flexibele werkuren én een mooie work/life balans.
Een top team: waarin nieuwe frisse ideeën en initiatieven steeds welkom zijn! Team-events, happy hours en een steeds legendarisch bedrijfsfeest horen daar ook bij.
Continu bijleren: knowledge sharing meetings, deelname aan conferenties en externe opleidingen. Kennisdeling en bijleren staan centraal! Afhankelijk van je eigen interesses en initiatieven, biedt Cegeka verschillende horizontale en verticale carrièrepaden.
We hechten waarde aan duurzaamheid door CO2-neutraliteit na te streven met de elektrificatie van ons wagenpark en een milieuvriendelijk datacenter. We ontwikkelen innovatieve oplossingen met een positieve impact op milieu, mens en maatschappij, en streven naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen gewaardeerd en gehoord wordt.

Persoonlijke begeleiding door managers, coaches en sparringpartners.

Cegeka draagt met trots het Top Employer-certificaat.

Teamevenementen, happy hours, sport en grandioos bedrijfsfeest.

Shape the future with confidence.

The Opportunity: Your Next Adventure Awaits?

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, building and optimizing EY's data ecosystem. You will help transform complex data into reliable, scalable and secure solutions that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization. Working closely with business stakeholders, data analysts and technology teams, you will drive the development of modern data platforms, improve data accessibility and contribute to innovative analytics and AI initiatives.

Design, develop and maintain scalable data pipelines and integration solutions.

Develop and maintain data models, data warehouses and reporting datasets to support business analytics and operational insights.
Integrate data from multiple internal and external sources while ensuring consistency, accuracy and reliability.
Support the development of business intelligence and data visualization solutions, including Power BI and other reporting platforms.
Implement data quality, governance and security standards across the data landscape.
Monitor and optimize the performance of data platforms, databases and processing workflows.
Contribute to automation initiatives that increase efficiency and reduce manual effort throughout the organization.
Coach and support colleagues by sharing knowledge and promoting data best practices across teams.

Your Profile

You hold a Master's degree or PhD in STEM, Econometrics, or a related field.
You have between 3 and max 5 of experience in data engineering, business intelligence or data platform development.
You have strong experience with data integration, ETL/ELT processes, and transforming complex datasets into reliable and scalable data models.
You are proficient in SQL and have a solid understanding of relational databases, data warehousing concepts, and data architecture principles.
You are familiar with Power BI and understand how to design, maintain, and optimize semantic models and reporting environments.
You have experience connecting and integrating data from multiple sources, such as SQL databases, APIs, XML, JSON, cloud platforms, and enterprise applications.

new_jobs.description:
We're a startup moving as fast as possible, willing to make mistakes and course-correct, with the ambition to build the best product on the market.
At Reverse Contact, we build the B2B identity resolution API for modern software companies. We help B2B products, SaaS companies, AI tools, and data teams resolve professional identities from fragmented signals: emails, social media URLs, names, domains, IP addresses, phone numbers, and more.
Data is at the core of everything we do. Our systems process and maintain over a billion data points, and keeping that volume accurate, up to date, and instantly queryable is both one of the most challenging and most exciting parts of the job.
Based in the heart of Paris, in the 3rd arrondissement, our team of 12 is split across Tech (4), Data (1), Product (1), Sales (3), CS (1), Ops (1), and the CEO.
Context

We're hiring a junior data engineer, with a start date planned for January 2027, to support our data engineer and take ownership of our entire existing data stack, helping us structure and grow this function.
Our tech stack:
TypeScript, Bun.js, Supabase, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Python, PySpark, Databricks, Snowflake, S3, Metabase, and Claude Code.
Mission

Progressively take ownership of our existing data platform, becoming autonomous on topics currently handled by our data engineer and our QA.

Automate and industrialize data pipelines (ingestion, transformation) to reduce manual work and ensure reliable delivery.

Work with the product team to answer business queries, turning business questions into reliable data answers.

Build and document an end-to-end data quality control pipeline, giving the team a reliable, up-to-date view of production data.

Be proactive on cross-functional projects and/or data science topics (classification, internal use cases), depending on your interests and appetite to grow the scope of the role.

Hard Skills At least 1 year of experience as a data engineer, ideally in a production environment with reliability and scaling challenges. You've already designed or evolved ingestion and transformation pipelines, and you're comfortable navigating a modern data stack.

Strong command of SQL, with the ability to write and optimize complex queries on large data volumes, with a focus on performance and reliability of analytical processing.

Solid Python practice for building robust data processing pipelines, from raw collection through to delivery to business teams.

Soft Skills Conversational English required. We have several English-speaking team members.

Curiosity along with strong written and verbal communication.

Comfortable in a fast-moving startup environment.

Nice-to-have Knowledge of ClickHouse

Prior experience in data science

Experience with API-first products

Benefits

Base salary + variable + equity (TBD): 35k to 38k + ~ 4k bonus

The opportunity to join a startup with significant day-to-day ownership of data, direct and visible impact, and a possible path toward a senior role. No fixed trajectory.

2 days of remote work per week, with a lot of flexibility in how you organize your time and the possibility of remote work during certain periods of the year depending on your needs.

Hiring Process

Chief of Staff — intro call

VP Engineering + Data Engineer — general discussion

Asynchronous technical test

Fit interview with the team (in office)

Reference is optional.
Details:
35-hour contract, choice of work equipment, Alan health insurance, ~€14/day meal vouchers.

new_jobs.description:
About AQEMIA

AQEMIA is a drug invention company dedicated to creating entirely new medicines to address major unmet medical needs.
At the core of our mission is QEMI
, our proprietary molecule-invention platform, which uniquely combines cutting-edge science with advanced technology. Powered by physics-based modeling, statistical mechanics, and generative AI, QEMI allows our teams to design novel drug candidates from first principles.

What makes AQEMIA different is our commitment to true innovation: our research is dedicated to the invention of new molecular entities, not the refinement of existing ones. We focus on inventing never-before-seen molecules
, without relying on experimental data, and advancing them into a growing pipeline of proprietary programs and strategic partnerships with leading pharmaceutical companies.

Our most advanced preclinical programs are currently in vivo optimization
, targeting diseases still waiting for effective treatments, offering our teams the opportunity to work on science that can make a real difference in people’s lives.

For more information, visit AQEMIA.com, our WTTJ Page, and our LinkedIn.

About Our Team

AQEMIA brings together a diverse, multidisciplinary team of 80+ professionals based in Paris and London. Our scientists and engineers, including chemists, physicists, machine learning experts, and software engineers, work side by side to push the boundaries of early-stage drug discovery.

This close collaboration across disciplines is central to our approach, enabling us to tackle complex scientific challenges from first principles and translate cutting-edge ideas into novel therapeutic candidates. At AQEMIA, team members are encouraged to contribute their expertise, learn from one another, and play an active role in shaping the future of drug invention.

About Our Engineering Department

The Engineering team builds and scales the technical foundations that power Aqemia’s drug discovery engine.

Bringing together expertise across software engineering, cloud infrastructure, data engineering, site reliability engineering (SRE), and scientific computing, the team designs and operates robust, secure, and high-performance platforms that enable Aqemia’s scientific and AI teams to experiment, train, deploy, and run models at scale.

Their work spans data infrastructure, scientific compute systems, cloud operations, orchestration, observability, CI/CD, developer tooling, and platform scalability. By transforming cutting-edge research into reliable and scalable systems, the team accelerates the discovery of new medicines while ensuring operational excellence and an outstanding developer experience.

The role

As our Senior Data Engineer, you'll own AQEMIA's data platform end to end - from ingestion through the pipeline to the trusted, model-ready datasets that power science, ML and analytics. What makes this role distinctive is the data itself: chemical structures, molecular conformations, physics- and ML-based predictions, and experimental results from CROs and partners.

A core part of the work is modelling these scientific entities well - establishing canonical identity, provenance and trustworthy lineage across heterogeneous, often messy sources - so scientists, and increasingly AI agents, can rely on them. You'll work at the intersection of software engineering, data infrastructure and scientific research, with real scope to shape architecture rather than just execute against it.

As AQEMIA moves toward more service and API-driven integration next year, you'll help make data fit for automation, expanding your impact from pipelines to the systems that consume them.

Responsibilities

Own AQEMIA's Bronze → Silver → Gold data pipelines end to end, from ingestion through transformation and delivery, maintaining lineage and traceability as data volume and complexity grow.
Model canonical scientific entities, compounds, structures, assays, predictions, establishing identity, provenance and trustworthy lineage across heterogeneous and often messy sources.
Set and uphold data quality standards through monitoring, validation, testing and alerting across critical pipelines, strengthening governance and observability so datasets stay trusted and accessible.
Partner with ML engineers, data scientists and researchers to build curated, model-ready datasets, translating scientific and business requirements into scalable data solutions.
Drive data architecture and engineering best practices, data modeling, testing, documentation, orchestration and deployment, in collaboration with the Engineering Manager and Staff Data Engineer on roadmap execution.
Build self-service capabilities and, looking ahead, APIs that make data fit for automation as AQEMIA moves toward more service-based integration.
Uphold engineering quality through code reviews, and mentor junior engineers by sharing knowledge and best practices as a senior individual contributor.

Qualifications

Deep experience in data engineering, with a track record of production systems that other teams depend on. We care about what you have built, not the year count.
Strong software engineering skills. You code, you review code, and you hold a quality bar.
Expert in Python and SQL.
Strong data modelling and relational database experience. You can defend an identity key.
Production experience with a cloud warehouse (we use Snowflake) and a transformation framework (we use dbt).
Experience with workflow orchestration (we use Airflow) and infrastructure-as-code (we use Terraform on AWS).
Any STEM degree or equivalent experience.

Nice‑to‑Have

Experience with AWS.
Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and modern data warehousing (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and object storage.
Experience in drug discovery, biotech, pharma or deeptech environments.
Exposure to AI-driven or data-intensive workflows, or experience working across disciplines (e.g. biology ↔ ML ↔ chemistry).
Experience implementing data governance, lineage and metadata management solutions.
Track record of improving platform scalability, reliability and operational maturity.

Our recruitment process

First discussion with our Talent Acquisition
Hiring Manager’s interview: you’ll meet directly with your future manager
Technical assessment of your skills in a deep-dive interview with the team
VP interview to share wider team vision and align motivations
Cultural fit interview with our co-founder and COO, Emmanuelle
Final interview with our co-founder and CEO, Maximillien

Why Join Us ?

At AQEMIA, we work for a mission: joining us means having your own impact on changing the way drugs are discovered, and helping to shape the direction of our fast-growing company and team.

Expanding Drug Discovery Pipeline
: Focused on critical therapeutic areas like Oncology, CNS, Immuno-inflammation... with in vivo proof of concept/patent stage programs. Collaborations with top Pharma, including a $140M Sanofi deal.

World-Class Interdisciplinary Team
: work alongside exceptional talent at the intersection of technology and life sciences. Our teams combine deep expertise in AI, physics-based modeling, biology, and medicinal chemistry to push the boundaries of innovation.

DeepTech Recognition
: AQEMIA is proud to be part of the French Tech 40
and France 2030
, highlighting our role as a key player in Europe’s DeepTech ecosystem.

Prime Location with Flexibility
: Our offices are located in the heart of Paris
and London (King’s Cross)
, with flexible work arrangements including up to two remote days per week.

Strong Financial Backing
: $100M raised from leading European and International investors

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
